jobs.description:
### **About Anthropic**

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

### About the role

The Endpoint team (Client Platform Engineering) manages the laptops and handsets every Anthropic employee works on, plus the infrastructure underneath them. We treat the fleet as a distributed platform, not a collection of devices, and every piece of configuration ships as code through pull requests, CI, staging, and a canary group. Today the mobile side of the fleet is BYOD. This role exists to change that. You will design and implement a corporate-issued mobile device program (managed company phones and managed Apple accounts) in every region Anthropic operates in, and take it from early design to production.

The team is deliberately lean and runs with high autonomy. You’ll define what a corporate mobile program looks like at Anthropic and own the platform decisions that get it there.

### Responsibilities

- Design the corporate-issued mobile device program: device standards, what we issue to whom, and how the program grows from a first region to everywhere Anthropic operates
- Own the global logistics of issuing hardware: procurement partners, regional coverage, spares, and refresh cycles
- Bring mobile configuration into the team’s config-as-code pipeline so mobile policies are reviewed, tested, and progressively rolled out like the rest of the fleet
- Build zero-touch enrollment: Apple Business Manager and ADE with managed Apple accounts on iOS, the zero-touch equivalent on Android, so a new phone works the first time without hands-on setup
- Own policy, compliance, and device lifecycle for the corporate fleet, from issue to wipe
- Build telemetry on the corporate fleet: which devices are checking in, OS and patch state, drift between reported and actual state
- Own managed app distribution for mobile, from app approval through update rollout
- Partner with Corporate Security on device posture, device trust signals, and travel devices for international trips
- Decide how corporate-issued and BYOD coexist, and own that boundary as the program rolls out

### You may be a good fit if you

- Have owned a global or multi-region mobile device program end to end, with 8+ years managing corporate fleets at thousands-of-devices scale
- Go deep on iOS device management: enrollment flows, Apple Business Manager and ADE, APNs and certificate lifecycle, declarative device management
- Have worked with Android device management and can hold your own in a mixed fleet
- Treat device configuration as code and have moved past clicking in consoles
- Have run the infrastructure under an MDM, not just administered a SaaS console: a self-hosted MDM server, AWS, Terraform, and configuration that ships as code
- Have built or launched a corporate device program, not just operated one, and can decide how it coexists with BYOD
- Excel at ambiguous problems that touch several teams at once
- Communicate technical concepts clearly to any audience
- View IT Engineering as requiring product engineering rigor
- Write clear documentation as a natural part of your workflow

### Strong candidates may also

- Have managed ChromeOS devices alongside a mobile fleet
- Have run a device program across multiple regions and dealt with the logistics that come with it
- Have built automated, progressive rollout systems with promotion gated on telemetry
- Bring proficiency in Swift for building device tooling
- Have used LLMs to automate operational work, or are excited to make Claude a teammate

### Technical Skills

- Python and shell scripting
- iOS and Android platform internals (depth on iOS, working knowledge of Android)
- Modern MDM or UEM platforms (Jamf, Intune, Workspace ONE, or equivalent)
- Running the infrastructure under an MDM (self-hosted servers, AWS GCP, Terraform)
- Querying live device state at fleet scale
- Mobile device lifecycle automation (enrollment, policy, patching, app distribution)
- GitOps and CI for configuration management
- Endpoint security fundamentals

Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be received on a rolling basis.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$285,000—$325,000 USD

### **Logistics**

**Minimum education:** Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

**Required field of study:** A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

**Minimum years of experience:** Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

**Location-based hybrid policy:** Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

**Visa sponsorship:** We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

**We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

**Your safety matters to us.** To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit [anthropic.com/careers](http://anthropic.com/careers) directly for confirmed position openings.

### **How we're different**

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

### **Come work with us!**

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. **Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:** Learn about [our policy](https://www.anthropic.com/candidate-ai-guidance) for using AI in our application process.

jobs.description:
MDM Data Engineer- Tampa, Florida

Be a part of a revolutionary change!

At Philip Morris International (PMI), we’ve chosen to do something incredible. We’re totally transforming our business and building our future on one clear purpose – to deliver a smoke-free future.

With huge change, comes huge opportunity. So, if you join us, you’ll enjoy the freedom to dream up and deliver better, brighter solutions and the space to move your career forward in endlessly different directions. Our success depends on people who are committed to our purpose and have an appetite for progress.

About the Role:

As an Analyst Data Enablement, you will be the point of contact for all aspects of data engineering within the MDM data domain. This role involves taking end-to-end engineering accountability, understanding the technology and business needs, and articulating them effectively into technical design MDM space and implementing data pipelines to meet the business requirements. Your role is instrumental in delivering on time, on budget, and with utmost quality data engineering pipelines within the architecture and governance framework.

Your Day-to-Day:

Ensure Data Quality and Compliance by applying expertise in MDM and data governance principles, including data governance frameworks and practices, to ensure the relevancy, quality, security, and compliance of master data.Develop MDM Platform Requirements while articulating requirements for MDM frameworks and tools in platforms like Profisee, Informatica, Reltio, and advocate their adoption across teams.Design and Model master data entities in collaboration with data modelers, data governance leads, and business stakeholders.Build, test, deploy, and evolve the capabilities for data curation and publishing into the data platform using standards and best practices to deliver high quality, standardized and harmonized consumable data domains for consumption by Advanced Analytics and Operational use cases.Closely partner and collaborate with other team members from architecture, Data Engineering, Data Governance, Product Managers, Delivery, Data Management Services to curate ingested source data across multiple sources from cleansing and validating to standardizing, harmonizing and transforming for a single view to the enterprise.Collaborate with Data Governance and business intelligence, driving engineering and technical implementation of the master data solution & services, ensuring accountability across the organizationLead MDM initiatives to establish a single source of truth, ensuring consistency and accessibility across business domains.Apply MDM Solutions to business problems by addressing business challenges by applying MDM and data governance concepts, leading workshops and gathering information to evaluate readiness for data governance strategies.Improve the current level of automation and Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) of our MDM platform as well as do code reviews for your peers.Provide direction to vendor staff within engineering domain for MDM tracking their quality of work and output.

Who we’re looking for:

Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Information Management, or Information Technology.5+ years of experience as an MDM Engineer with end to end design and development and hands on experience with MDM Tools (Profisee, SAP MDG, informatica, Reltio etc.) and Snowflake, Azure SQL database.Knowledge of standard data models within master data domains – Product, Customer, Finance, Reference Data, etc.Advanced SQL programming and building ETL/ELT processes using cloud platforms like Azure Data Factory or Matillion.Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Information Management, or Information Technology.Legally authorized to work in the U.S.Commutable distance to Tampa, Florida.

Annual Base Salary Range: $88,000-$110,000

What we offer:

We offer a competitive base salary, annual bonus (applicable based on level of position), great medical, dental and vision coverage, 401k with a generous company match, incredible wellness benefits, commuter benefits, pet insurance, generous PTO, and much more!We have implemented Smart Work, a hybrid model of working that promotes flexibility in the workplace.Seize the freedom to define your future and ours. We’ll empower you to take risks, experiment and explore.Be part of an inclusive, diverse culture where everyone’s contribution is respected; Collaborate with some of the world’s best people and feel like you belong.Pursue your ambitions and develop your skills with a global business – our staggering size and scale provides endless opportunities to progress.Take pride in delivering our promise to society: To improve the lives of millions of smokers.

PMI is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

PMI is headquartered in Stamford, Conn., and its U.S. affiliates have more than 3,000 employees.

PMI has been an entirely separate company from Altria and Philip Morris USA since 2008. PMI’s affiliates first entered the U.S. market following the company’s acquisition of Swedish Match in late 2022. Philip Morris International and its U.S. affiliates are working to deliver a smoke-free future. Since 2008, PMI has invested $12.5 billion globally to develop, scientifically substantiate and commercialize innovative smoke-free products for adults who would otherwise continue to smoke with the goal of transitioning legal-age consumers who smoke to better alternatives. In 2022, PMI acquired Swedish Match – a leader in oral nicotine delivery – creating a global smoke-free champion led by the IQOS and ZYN brands. The U.S. Food and Drug Administration has authorized versions of PMI’s IQOS electronically heated tobacco devices and Swedish Match’s General snus as Modified Risk Tobacco Products and renewal applications for these products are presently pending before the FDA. For more information, please visit www.pmi.com/us and www.pmiscience.com.

jobs.description:
Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced Senior Windows Endpoint Engineer – MECM/SCCM & Test Lab to support enterprise Windows endpoint testing, validation, and test lab operations within a Federal IT environment in Florence, Kentucky.

This is a Windows endpoint engineering position—not a traditional application QA, web testing, or SDET role. Candidates should have hands-on enterprise experience with Windows 10/11 endpoint engineering, MECM/SCCM, operating system deployment/imaging, software package validation, Group Policy, drivers/firmware, and endpoint configuration testing.

This position requires full-time onsite support in Florence, KY. This is not a remote or hybrid position.

The successful candidate will have 5–8+ years of experience in enterprise Windows endpoint engineering, desktop engineering, endpoint test lab, deployment engineering, or endpoint validation environments. The ideal candidate will combine strong Windows endpoint engineering knowledge with a disciplined approach to testing, troubleshooting, documentation, and production-readiness validation.

This is a hands-on senior technical position responsible for validating Windows endpoint images and upgrades, software packages, patches, configuration changes, Group Policy, hardware/peripherals, drivers, firmware, and related endpoint changes before pilot and enterprise production deployment.

The engineer will develop and execute structured tests, troubleshoot failures, document defects and results, retest corrective actions, and provide technical recommendations regarding production readiness.

Proposed Contract Role: Test Lab Subject Matter Expert (SME)

Key Responsibilities

Plan, design, execute, and document comprehensive Windows endpoint hardware, software, configuration, and deployment validation within an enterprise IT test lab.
Test and validate enterprise Windows 10/11 endpoint images, operating system configurations, and in-place OS upgrades before production deployment.
Validate MECM/SCCM software packages and deployment configurations, including installation, upgrade, uninstall, rollback, detection, execution context, reboot behavior, and compatibility.
Test endpoint imaging and deployment processes, including MECM/SCCM Operating System Deployment (OSD), task sequences, boot images, driver packages, and related configurations.
Perform application compatibility testing across supported enterprise Windows configurations and identify issues that could affect pilot or production deployment.
Test and validate Windows patches, software updates, security updates, and releases prior to enterprise deployment.
Test Group Policy (GPO), configuration baselines, endpoint security settings, and other Windows configuration changes.
Validate drivers, firmware/BIOS, hardware configurations, and peripheral compatibility within representative enterprise endpoint configurations.
Develop and execute structured test plans, test cases, procedures, acceptance criteria, and validation activities based on technical and operational requirements.
Document test results, defects, failures, configuration issues, reproduction procedures, and recommended corrective actions.
Troubleshoot failed tests, package installations, imaging/deployment failures, compatibility issues, and endpoint configuration problems.
Perform root-cause analysis in collaboration with software deployment, endpoint engineering, cybersecurity, infrastructure, and support teams.
Retest corrected packages, images, configurations, drivers, or deployments to verify successful remediation.
Support automation of endpoint testing, validation, troubleshooting, and reporting using PowerShell or related technologies.
Ensure tested configurations comply with applicable security, configuration-management, change-management, and release-management standards.
Maintain test procedures, technical documentation, test records, defect information, configuration information, and validation results.
Provide technically sound go/no-go and production-readiness recommendations, including identified risks, unresolved defects, and required corrective actions.
Support continuous improvement of endpoint test lab procedures, standards, automation, and validation processes.

Required Qualifications

5–8+ years of experience in enterprise Windows endpoint engineering, desktop engineering, endpoint deployment, endpoint test lab, endpoint validation, or closely related enterprise IT environments.
Hands-on experience supporting and troubleshooting enterprise Windows 10/11 endpoints.
Hands-on experience with Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (MECM/SCCM) in an enterprise environment.
Experience with Windows endpoint imaging, Operating System Deployment (OSD), task sequences, or related Windows provisioning/deployment technologies.
Experience testing and validating enterprise software packages and endpoint deployments.
Experience validating software installation, upgrade, uninstall, rollback, reboot behavior, and application compatibility.
Experience testing Windows patches, updates, releases, drivers, firmware, or endpoint configuration changes.
Experience with Group Policy (GPO), Windows configuration baselines, or enterprise endpoint configuration management.
Demonstrated ability to identify, document, troubleshoot, and retest endpoint, deployment, configuration, and software-package failures.
Experience developing or executing structured test plans, test cases, procedures, and technical validation documentation.
Strong Windows endpoint troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills.
Knowledge of enterprise endpoint security, configuration management, change management, and release management practices.
Ability to independently evaluate technical results and make recommendations regarding production deployment readiness.
Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to clearly document technical findings, risks, defects, and recommendations.
Ability to collaborate effectively with endpoint engineering, software deployment, cybersecurity, infrastructure, service desk, and other technical teams.
Ability to work onsite full-time in Florence, Kentucky.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience supporting U.S. Federal Government enterprise IT environments.
Experience supporting the U.S. Department of the Treasury or Internal Revenue Service (IRS) is highly desirable.
Advanced experience with MECM/SCCM software deployment, application/package management, OSD, task sequences, boot images, and driver packages.
Experience with Windows 10/11 Enterprise imaging, deployment, and in-place upgrade validation.
Experience with Microsoft Intune, co-management, or other Microsoft endpoint-management technologies.
Experience testing and validating Active Directory Group Policy (GPO), configuration baselines, and endpoint security settings.
Experience with BIOS/firmware, driver, hardware, and peripheral compatibility validation.
Experience with enterprise patch-management and vulnerability-remediation validation.
Experience using PowerShell for endpoint engineering, troubleshooting, validation, or test-process automation.
Experience working within formal Federal or enterprise change, release, incident, and configuration-management processes.
Relevant Microsoft, CompTIA, or other endpoint/infrastructure certifications are preferred but not required.

Technical Skills

Primary Technologies and Functions

Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (MECM/SCCM)
Microsoft Windows 10/11 Enterprise
Windows endpoint/desktop engineering
Endpoint imaging and Operating System Deployment (OSD)
MECM/SCCM task sequences

LOCAL CANDIDATES ONLY OR THOSE WILLING TO RELOCATE AT OWN EXPENSE. THERE WILL BE NO RELOCATION ASSISTANCE PROVIDED.

JOB SUMMARY

Our client is an organization operating in a regulated, industrial environment with field-operations and distributed workforce needs. The company relies on enterprise-grade Microsoft 365 collaboration and productivity platforms to enable secure, scalable communication, knowledge management, and AI-driven productivity across its workforce.

The Digital Workplace Architect owns the organization's Microsoft 365 collaboration and productivity ecosystem, including SharePoint Online, Teams, Microsoft 365 Copilot, Microsoft Search, and Power Platform governance. This role establishes secure, scalable standards for collaboration, AI enablement, automation, records, external sharing, and workforce productivity.

REQUIREMENTS

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, Engineering, or related discipline; equivalent experience considered.Demonstrated hands-on experience architecting, administering, engineering, and supporting enterprise Microsoft 365 solutions, including SharePoint Online, Teams, Microsoft 365 Copilot, and Power Platform governance.Strong knowledge of SharePoint information architecture, permissions, search, content management, governance, and site lifecycle.Ability to translate business requirements into practical architectures, technical standards, implementation plans, and operating models.Proficiency with PowerShell and working knowledge of Microsoft Graph, APIs, integration patterns, and automation.Excellent communication, facilitation, prioritization, influence, and execution skills.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in a regulated, industrial, or field-operations environment.Experience establishing centers of excellence, champion programs, citizen-developer guardrails, or enterprise adoption programs.Relevant Microsoft certifications such as MS-102, SC-100, SC-400, or current Microsoft Copilot and AI credentials.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Microsoft 365 Architecture & Strategy

Own the Microsoft 365 collaboration roadmap, reference architectures, technical standards, and lifecycle strategy.Architect secure, scalable solutions across SharePoint Online, Teams, Microsoft Search, Copilot, and approved integrations.

SharePoint Online, Content & Knowledge Architecture

Serve as the primary technical authority for SharePoint Online architecture, administration, and modernization.Design information architecture, hub structures, taxonomy, metadata, content types, search, permissions, and provisioning standards.Govern SharePoint site creation, ownership, external sharing, guest access, and lifecycle standards.Lead content migration and modernization efforts while keeping content organized, discoverable, secure, and governed.

Microsoft 365 Copilot & AI Enablement

Lead readiness, governance, architecture, and adoption for Microsoft 365 Copilot.Assess permissions hygiene, oversharing risk, search quality, retention controls, and compliance readiness before AI enablement.Define standards for Copilot usage, AI-enabled solutions, enterprise search, approved connectors, and future agent governance.Partner with stakeholders to prioritize high-value AI use cases while balancing innovation, security, governance, and business value.

Governance, Security, Compliance & Risk

Partner with Cybersecurity, Legal, Compliance, Internal Audit, and Records Management to define and enforce governance.Design controls for least-privilege administration, access reviews, external collaboration, guest access, and permissions governance.Own Power Platform governance standards and identify security, operational, legal, privacy, and governance risks.

Engineering, Automation & Operational Excellence

Use PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, APIs, administrative portals, and automation to improve governance, reporting, maintenance, and operations.Perform discovery, design, configuration, testing, deployment, troubleshooting, and operational transition activities.Define monitoring, resiliency, release management, support requirements, and service health standards.Create documentation, mentor administrators and citizen developers, and promote governed adoption and platform standardization.

BENEFITS

Medical, dental, vision, coverage in addition to life and disability insurance plans.Paid Vacation Days and Paid Holidays.Retirement and Savings (401K) Plan with Company match.Referral bonus with no cap on amount of referrals.Paid Training.

jobs.description: Journey with us! Combine your career goals and sense of adventure by joining our exciting team of employees. Royal Caribbean Group is pleased to offer a competitive compensation and benefits package, and excellent career development opportunities, each offering unique ways to explore the world. We are proud to be the vacation-industry leader with global brands — including Royal Caribbean International, Celebrity Cruises and Silversea Cruises — the most innovative fleet and private destinations, and the best people. Together, we are dedicated to turning the vacation of a lifetime into a lifetime of vacations for our guests. The Royal Caribbean Group’s Data Analytics and AI Team has an exciting career opportunity for a full time Senior Engineer, Informatica MDM reporting to the Director of Enterprise MDM & Quality. This position will work on-site in Miramar, Florida. Position Summary We are seeking an experienced MDM Developer with a strong focus on Informatica SAS MDM and Party Model implementation. The ideal candidate will be responsible for configuring and customizing the MDM platform, ensuring data accuracy and consistency, integrating data from various sources, and optimizing performance. Proficiency in data quality management, data modeling, and effective communication with cross-functional teams is essential for this role. Essential Duties and Responsibilities Informatica SAS MDM Configuration: Configure and customize Informatica SAS MDM to implement the Party Model, defining entity types, relationships, business rules, match and merge strategies, and user interfaces. Data Modelling: Work with data architects and stakeholders to design and maintain the data model for party-related entities within the Informatica SAS MDM platform, ensuring data accuracy and consistency. Data Integration: Integrate data from various source systems into Informatica’s SAS MDM platform through IDMC, performing data profiling, cleansing, and transformation to ensure data quality and integrity. Match and Merge: Implement match and merge rules to identify and consolidate duplicate records within the party entities, enabling a single and accurate view of each entity. Configure Address Doctor Engine-reference and email and phone verification. Data Quality Management: Define and implement data quality rules and workflows within the SAS MDM system to monitor, measure, and improve data quality across party related data. Experieince working with Refernce 360 and it’s usage within the MDM domain. Performance Optimization: Identify performance bottlenecks within the SAS MDM system and optimize data loading, matching, and retrieval processes for efficient and seamless data operations. Testing and Validation: Conduct unit testing and integration testing to validate MDM configurations, ensuring accuracy and completeness of data within the MDM repository. Documentation: Maintain comprehensive technical documentation, including design specifications, configuration guides, and troubleshooting manuals for the MDM implementation. Build UNIX shell scripting, Pre-Session, Post-Session UNIX Commands for automation of Informatica job scheduling, backup of repository etc. Work with SFTP/SSH file transfer and loading using SQL, PL/SQL, SQL *Loader. Qualifications, Knowledge, and Skills Bachelor's Degree from an accredited college or university with a major in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, or other related scientific or technical discipline. 4+ years of experience in MDM Development experience with a focus on Informatica MDM and Party Model implementation. Must have hands on experience implementing Informatica’s SAS MDM application. Experieince working with Refernce 360 and it’s usage within the MDM domain. Experience working with CAI, CDI and CDQ is a must. In-depth knowledge of Informatica’s SAS MDM tools, including IDMC, and their functionalities for party entities. Familiarity with data modelling principles and data integration techniques. Strong understanding of data quality management and data governance practices within an MDM environment. Proficiency in data profiling, data cleansing, and data transformation processes. Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills to troubleshoot MDM-related issues. Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with cross functional teams and stakeholders. Knowledgeable in technology and software development processes. Good presentation development and delivery skills. Fair understanding of Agile methodologies (e.g., Scrum, Kanban) required. Experience with travel and hospitality industry is a huge plus. Knowledge of Data Warehouses/Lakehouse architectures, Master Data Management, Data Quality Management, Data Integration, and Data Warehouse architecture. Agency and Third-Party Submissions: Please note this is a direct search by the Company, and applications through agencies and other third parties will not be accepted, nor will fees be paid for unsolicited resumes. Any unsolicited resumes will be considered the Company's property. We know there's a lot to consider. As you go through the application process, our recruiters will be glad to provide guidance, and more relevant details to answer any additional questions. Thank you again for your interest in Royal Caribbean Group. We'll hope to see you onboard soon! jobs.summary: Senior TechOps Engineer We're hiring a Senior TechOps Engineer to own the reliability, security, and automation backbone of our contact center technology platform. This is a high-impact, high-autonomy role for someone who thinks architecturally, moves...
jobs.description:
Senior TechOps Engineer We're hiring a Senior TechOps Engineer to own the reliability, security, and automation backbone of our contact center technology platform. This is a high-impact, high-autonomy role for someone who thinks architecturally, moves decisively, and takes genuine pridein the systems they build. You'll set the technical direction for our infrastructure, mentor a growing team, and be the person who prevents problems before they become incidents.

ACD Direct, Inc. is an innovative, virtual company that thrives on brokering solutions for our non-profit clients.ACD's heartbeat and competitive edge is powered by our people. Our company has grown from providing routine call center services to providing high-level, full-scale donor support resources and products. Our proprietary scripting engine, web forms and custom-built reporting enable clients to successfully conduct large-scale fundraising campaigns with accuracy and creativity. ACD is a B2B Contact Center Technology company building and operating the infrastructure that keeps modern contact centers running at scale. Our platform is cloud-native, security-first, and built by a fully distributed team spread across the United States. We move fast, document everything, and treat operational excellence as a core value - not an afterthought.

Applicant preferred to be located within a 50 mile radius of Salt Lake City, Utah. Although position is remote employee will be required to visit data center on a quarterly basis. It is not required for the employee to be located in the state of Utah.

You will:

Design and implement robust CI/CD frameworks for serverless and containerized (Kubernetes/Docker) applications. Lead the transition to fully versioned infrastructure - owning IaC strategy using Terraform, Pulumi, or Bicep to ensure environment parity and rapid recovery. Own the availability, performance, and survivability of production environments; define and monitor SLOs/SLIs to maintain 99.9%+ uptime targets. Serve as the primary owner of the organization's security posture - implement automated vulnerability scanning, IAM least-privilege policies, and audit logging for strict PCI DSS compliance. Partner with QA and Software Engineering leads to embed DevSecOps practices into the early stages of the SDLC. Lead root-cause analysis (RCA) for complex system failures and drive implementation of preventative automations to eliminate repeat incidents. Architect and improve monitoring, alerting, and observability tooling across all production and non-production environments. Mentor junior and mid-level TechOps engineers - conducting code/config reviews, sharing expertise, and contributing to team capability development. Champion TechOps best practices across the team; set the documentation and process standards others follow. Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to evaluate new technologies and deliver infrastructure roadmap items on time. What You Bring:

5+ years of professional experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), or Systems Engineering. Deep expertise with CI/CD pipelines and release automation across complex, multi-environment systems. Strong cloud platform mastery (AWS, Azure, or GCP) - you can architect a solution and then build it. Expert-level Kubernetes experience; comfortable designing and troubleshooting production container workloads. Advanced IaC proficiency using Terraform, Pulumi, Bicep, or equivalent - you treat infrastructure like software. Demonstrated experience owning PCI DSS compliance for a production environment. Strong background in security engineering: IAM, vulnerability management, automated scanning, and audit logging. Ability to define and track SLOs/SLIs and translate reliability data into infrastructure improvements. Track record of mentoring engineers and raising the overall skill level of a team. Excellent written and verbal communication skills; you can explain trade-offs to engineers and business stakeholders alike. Self-directed and highly organized - thrives in a fully remote, async-first environment. Nice to Have:

Experience with contact center platforms (Genesys, Five9, Amazon Connect, Twilio, or similar). Exposure to SMS/telecom infrastructure and carrier APIs. Background in B2B SaaS or telecom infrastructure environments. Contributions to open-source DevOps or infrastructure tooling. Certifications in AWS, Azure, GCP, or Kubernetes (CKA/CKAD). Leadership and Scope:

As our Senior TechOps Engineer, you'll have broad scope and genuine ownership - not just execution tickets. You'll drive architectural decisions, define standards the rest of the team follows, and be an active voice in shaping our infrastructure roadmap. We're a lean team, which means your fingerprints will be on everything. That's a feature, not a bug. This role reports directly to the Technology Operations Manager and works closely with Engineering and Security leadership. You will be the go-to infrastructure authority for the organization.

How we will support you?

Salary:

$86,000-100,000/yr depending on experience level - Remote and Inoffice Work

- Equipment Provided:

Laptop Headset Monthly Cell Phone Stipend Monthly Internet Stipend - Benefits:

Medical/Vision and Dental Insurance Personal Accident Insurance 401(k)/Roth with matching Tiered PTO based upon length of employment Discounts & Life Services offered through Optum EAP - Team Environment – The opportunity to work with a great team who strives for excellence, where the average tenure is well over 6 years. (Not bad for a company who has been in business for 20 years!)

ACD Direct, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. All aspects of employment including the decision to hire, promote, discipline, or discharge, will be based on merit, competence, performance, and business needs. We do not discriminate based on any status protected under federal, state, or local law. We are a fully remote company. Our team spans every U.S. time zone and we are committed to building an inclusive, async-friendly culture where great work speaks for itself.

Provide day-to-day application support for assigned platforms.Troubleshoot and resolve application issues, including user access, synchronization, and performance problems.Serve as a primary point of contact for application-related incidents, service requests, and user inquiries.Serve as subject matter expert (SME) for all functional and technical aspects of the applications and associated technical components.Partner with other team members on any application functional or technical issues or questions.Provide third level support for application issues, including issues with application functionality, environment configuration, and / or system integrations.Coordinate with relevant software vendor(s) to escalate and resolve complex issues.Perform root cause analysis for recurring issues and implement preventive measures. Our Food Division is a complete broad line multi-state distributor, and our Beverage Division operates throughout the state of Texas as a proud distributor of Anheuser‑Busch products, craft and import beer brands, spirits, and wine.

We are dedicated to the growth and success of our business, our customers, and our employees—continuing our commitment to delivering quality since 1906.

Transform the Employee Experience Through Technology
Who We Are
For more than 120 years, Ben E. Keith has served customers and communities as one of the nation’s leading distributors of foodservice products and premium beverages. Our success is built on exceptional people, strong relationships, and a commitment to service and innovation. Our Digital Workplace team uses Microsoft 365, Microsoft Copilot, and other modern technologies to create a connected, productive employee experience and help thousands of employees work smarter.

Why This Opportunity Stands Out
This highly visible role is for a relationship builder, storyteller, trainer, and technology advocate. You will combine technical expertise with energy, curiosity, creativity, and personality to make technology approachable, engaging, and useful. If you enjoy presenting, leading workshops, helping others learn, and bringing your authentic self to work, you will fit right in.

Help lead Microsoft Copilot and AI adoption across the enterprise
Shape how employees use technology, collaborate, and learn

Join a stable, growing company with meaningful career opportunities

Collaborate with IT, HR, Corporate Communications, and business teams to advance digital

transformation

Continuously evaluate how AI can improve employee adoption, reinforce learning, and help employees build confidence and proficiency with new technologies.

Required Qualifications

Ability to explain technical concepts to non‑technical audiences
Experience leading projects and collaborating across multiple teams

Experience supporting organizational change management initiatives
Experience developing adoption metrics, reporting, and analytics
Experience supporting AI, automation, or digital transformation programs

Relationship‑building and stakeholder management
Customer focus and a passion for helping others succeed
Creativity in technology adoption and employee engagement
Analytical thinking, sound judgment, and problem‑solving
Collaboration, adaptability, and accountability

At Ben E. Keith, culture is more than a set of values. It is how we work together, support one another, and serve our customers every day.

People First: We foster respect, trust, inclusion, and collaboration.
One Team: We work toward shared goals, support one another, and celebrate success together.

We are committed to creating an environment where employees feel valued, supported, and empowered to make a meaningful impact.

What It's Like to Work Here
When you join Ben E. Keith, you can expect:

A collaborative, energetic team that genuinely enjoys working together
Opportunities to work with Microsoft Copilot, AI, and the Microsoft 365 platform
Leaders who encourage innovation, creativity, and professional growth
Meaningful work that directly affects employee productivity and engagement
Freedom to bring your personality, communication style, and unique talents to your work
A workplace where relationship‑building is as important as technical expertise

We work hard, support one another, and make time to have fun while delivering results together.

Grow With Us
We are committed to helping employees build rewarding careers. Whether you want to deepen your technical expertise, become a subject matter expert in AI and collaboration technologies, expand your leadership capabilities, or pursue a new career path, we provide the training, mentorship, and support to help you grow.

Join our team and help shape the future of work at Ben E. Keith.

True Zero Technologies, a veteran-owned small business, was founded on the principle that the purposeful enablement of people and technology in an organization directly ties to the quality of its outcomes.

True Zero Technologies , a veteran-owned small business, was founded on the principle that the purposeful enablement of people and technology in an organization directly ties to the quality of its outcomes. True Zero recognizes that those outcomes begin and end with our people, and that is what we have built a community of like-minded, driven, and passionate individuals and innovators who are aligned in a common goal of delivering top-tier services to our customers. Our culture and commitment have been recognized through numerous accolades, including being named one of the Best Places to Work in 2023 in two categories (“Prosperous and Thriving” ($5MM–$50MM in gross revenue) and “Mid-Atlantic Region” (DC, DE, MD, NC, VA, WV)), and again in 2025 as a Best Places to Work honoree. In addition, True Zero earned coveted spots on the Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing companies in America in 2022, 2023, and 2025 , a testament to our sustained growth driven by our people-first approach and unwavering dedication to excellence.

True Zero is seeking a Device & Endpoint Specialist to lead the Devices pillar for enterprise Zero Trust architecture and implementation support. The role defines reusable patterns for device identity, posture, compliance, endpoint protection, secure configuration, and the use of device signals in access decisions.

The specialist supports system implementation waves by validating endpoint dependencies, testing device-focused controls, and ensuring device posture is integrated with identity, network, application, and analytics capabilities.

Position Responsibilities

- Develop device and endpoint Zero Trust architecture and implementation patterns.

- Define device identity, posture, health, compliance, endpoint protection, and access signal requirements.

- Assess endpoint and device management technologies for interoperability and contribution to enterprise Zero Trust objectives.

- Support implementation planning, pilot execution, test cases, regression testing, and operational readiness.

- Coordinate device-related dependencies with identity, network, application, data, and automation teams.

- Document implementation results, exceptions, deviations, and recommendations for continuous improvement.

Job Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.

- Five or more years of endpoint security, device management, desktop engineering, or enterprise security engineering experience.

- Experience with endpoint protection, EDR, MDM/UEM, configuration management, and compliance assessment.

- Knowledge of device-centric Zero Trust and conditional access concepts.

- Strong troubleshooting and technical documentation skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

- Experience with Microsoft Intune, Defender, CrowdStrike, Tanium, or comparable enterprise endpoint platforms.

- Experience supporting Federal endpoint security requirements.

- Experience integrating endpoint signals into identity and access decisions.

Preferred Certifications:

One or more of the following is preferred:

- Security+

- Microsoft Endpoint Administrator

- CISSP

- CySA+

Position Summary

Our Deloitte Cyber team understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Join our team to deliver powerful solutions to help our clients navigate the ever-changing threat landscape. Through powerful solutions and managed services that simplify complexity, we enable our clients to operate with resilience, grow with confidence, and proactively manage to secure success.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/31/26.

Work you'll do

As a Microsoft 365 Security Consultant, you will be at the front lines with our clients supporting them with their Cloud Cyber Risk needs specifically helping them navigate the journey on securing their Microsoft 365 (M365) platform. This will include:

- Function as onshore engineer/consultant for the following Microsoft technologies: Purview, Intune, Sentinel, Security Copilot, Entra ID, Defender for Office, Defender for Endpoints and Servers, Defender for Vulnerabilities, Defender for Cloud Apps, Defender XDR and SCCM

- Conduct cloud security analysis, recommendations and configurations of prospective clients' Microsoft Entra ID, Office 365 (O365), Exchange Online, Teams, OneDrive for Business, and SharePoint Online environments based on Deloitte's Microsoft 365 Cyber Risk Framework. This can include Microsoft's cloud solutions such as Entra, Purview, Defender, Intune, and Sentinel.

- Perform technical health checks for these M365 platforms/environments prior to broader deployments.

- Support proof of concept and production deployments of these cloud technologies.

- Assist clients with transitions to the Microsoft 365 security services such as solution setup and service configuration, focused on risk mitigation. Additional technologies include MFA, Conditional Access, Purview Compliance Manager, M365 Defender, Defender for O365, Defender for Cloud Apps (MDCA), Purview Information Protection (MPIP), Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP).

- Assist clients with configuration and delivery of cloud security and compliance reports.

- Provide technical support for M365 E5 security services and resolve service-related issues through research and troubleshooting and working with Microsoft.

- Implement industry leading practices around M365 E5 cyber risks and cloud security for clients.

- Design and develop cloud-specific security policies, standards and procedures e.g., O365 tenant management and configuration, identify management and access control, auditing and monitoring, security incident and event management, data protection (classification/labeling, DLP, encryption), user and administrator account management, SSO, conditional access controls and password/key management.

- Troubleshoot system level problems in a multi-vendor, multi-protocol network environment.

- Document platform technical issues, analysis, client communication, and resolution as part of cyber risk mitigation steps.

- Execute on M365 security engagements during different phases of the lifecycle - Discover, Assess, Design, Deploy/Test, Hypercare/Handover.

- Implement industry leading practices around M365 cyber risks and cloud security for clients.

- Provide internal technical training to personnel as needed.

- Acting as a subject matter expert on cloud cyber risk for Microsoft Purview, Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Defender, and Microsoft Sentinel capabilities.

- Contribute to Point-of-Views (PoVs) on providing leading practices to our clients on the M365 security challenges they face.

The team you'll join

Our Enterprise Security offering embeds security in all aspects of digital transformation by securing a client's technical backbone while enabling secure digital transformation. Includes security architecture, secure development and deployment, end-to-end cyber cloud capabilities, application security, and security for emerging technologies and connected products.

Required:

- Working experience in at least two of the areas listed below.

- 2+ years of experience in technical consulting, client problem solving, architecting and designing solutions in a consulting role

- 2+ years of hands-on technical experience with Microsoft 365 enterprise-level messaging and collaboration services (Teams, OneDrive for Business, Exchange Online, Entra ID, SharePoint Online, O365 administration and setup) in implementation and operations.

- 2+ years of hands-on technical experience with enterprise-level systems management systems such as SCCM and Intune and endpoint engineering (MEM) and mobile device management (MAM & MDM)) implementation or operations.

- 2+ years of hands-on technical and project / professional experience enterprise-with at least two of the following technologies: Microsoft Endpoint Security Platforms (e.g. Defender for Endpoints and Defender for Servers), Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft's email security platform (Defender for Office), Microsoft Purview & Entra ID

- Ability to travel 50%, on average, within North America, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.

- Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Ideally the following technical experience is a plus in any of the technologies below:

- Microsoft Security Copilot

- Defender for Vulnerabilities

- Defender for Cloud Apps

- Defender XDR

- SCCM

Preferred:

- Microsoft Certifications such as: (SC-900, SC-100, SC-200, SC-300, SC-400),

- Cyber Certifications such as: CCSP, CCSK, CISSP, CCNP, and CCNA.

- BA/BS Degree preferred. Ideally in Computer Science, Cyber Security, Information Security, Engineering, Information Technology.

jobs.title: Systems Engineer - Microsoft 365 Security & Compliance / Endpoint Security Engineer (GCC)
jobs.summary: Description Leidos is seeking an experienced M365 Security and Compliance Administrator to join our Information Technology team. This role requires a seasoned professional who can strategically manage and enhance the security and compliance posture of the...
jobs.description:
Description
Leidos is seeking an experienced M365 Security and Compliance Administrator to join our Information Technology team. This role requires a seasoned professional who can strategically manage and enhance the security and compliance posture of the M365 environment within a GCC (Government Community Cloud) tenant, particularly in a federal agency context. This senior engineering role sits at the center of the organization’s device, identity, and M365 security ecosystem.

The engineer is responsible for protecting enterprise Windows, macOS, iOS/iPadOS endpoints; ensuring compliant, reliable access to M365 services, and driving rapid engineering responses to vulnerabilities, outages, and operational risks. The successful candidate will apply with deep technical expertise, cross-platform engineering capability, and high operational security judgment.

Role Summary: Responsible for securing and maintaining compliance of the Microsoft 365 (M365) ecosystem and enterprise endpoints. Leads security governance, implements and enforces controls across M365, email, identity, devices, and telemetry, and provides incident response and audit/ATO support to ensure alignment with federal and organizational security requirements.

Primary Responsibilities
Strategic security oversight & governance

Lead the development, implementation, and ongoing management of M365 security policies, standards, and technical guardrails aligned to federal requirements and organizational controls.

Own governance for data protection capabilities including document classification, labeling, retention, and Data Loss Prevention (DLP) using Microsoft Purview.

Email security & compliance management (Exchange Online)
Define and enforce email security policies such as encryption, sensitivity labeling, and secure mail flow to reduce unauthorized disclosure.

Implement and maintain email encryption solutions (S/MIME and/or Microsoft Information Protection) to protect confidentiality of email communications.

Administer and monitor anti-spam, anti-phishing, and anti-malware protections to defend against evolving threats.

Identity, access, and conditional access (Entra ID)
Engineer and validate device-compliance–based Conditional Access policies across Windows, macOS, and mobile platforms.

Investigate and remediate Conditional Access failures, identity anomalies, and external/guest access issues, including M365 B2B trust and secure partner collaboration requirements.

Endpoint & device security engineering (Intune)
Design, test, and deploy Intune configuration and compliance policies for Windows, macOS, and iOS/iPadOS, including Enrollment Status Pages (ESPs) and OOBE workflows.

Develop remediation scripts (PowerShell/platform scripts/configuration profiles) to close compliance gaps and enforce security baselines.

Coordinate enterprise rollout of urgent vulnerability mitigations and validated vendor fixes; support vulnerability reviews and baseline rebuilds.

Risk management & compliance assurance (ATO / controls)
Establish and operate a risk management approach to identify, assess, and mitigate security risks across the M365 ecosystem.

Support ATO/control assessment activities by drafting implementation statements, collecting artifacts, and providing evidence aligned to audit/logging requirements.

Security monitoring, SIEM, and telemetry engineering (Defender / Sentinel)
Lead integration and operational management of Microsoft Defender and Microsoft Sentinel for threat detection, alerting, and response across M365.

Build and maintain SIEM integrations/connectors (e.g., M365, collaboration and identity systems) and develop ingestion pipelines (e.g., Azure Function Apps) for third-party logs.

Tune audit retention, analytic rules, and alert logic to improve signal quality and investigation readiness.

Incident response & operational support / collaboration
Provide Tier 3 troubleshooting for device compliance failures, identity/access incidents, telemetry gaps, and OS/app protection issues.

Partner with cross-functional teams to align security solutions with business objectives, deliver technical leadership, and support enterprise syncs and operational reviews.

Continuous improvement & innovation
Stay current on M365 security/compliance updates, industry trends, and emerging capabilities; drive improvements to security posture and operational efficiency (including use of GCC Copilot where appropriate).

Platform Scope / Tooling Microsoft 365 (GCC), Microsoft Purview (DLP/labels/classification/retention), Exchange Online, Entra ID & Conditional Access, Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Defender, Microsoft Sentinel, Azure (Function Apps / Log Analytics), plus integrations with collaboration/IT systems (e.g., ticketing and SaaS log sources).
“Day in the Life"

Morning
Review Sentinel incidents, Defender telemetry gaps, and compliance drift.

Respond to overnight CAP failures, Slack EMM issues, or OS update regressions.

Join device/enterprise standups.
Midday
Build/test remediation scripts (CVE fixes, NTLM disablement, compliance corrections).

Deploy or test Intune configuration profiles, ESP changes, or app protection updates.

Troubleshoot support cases with Microsoft (Purview DSPM, Copilot logs, Okta connector).
Afternoon
Conduct cross-team investigations (external-user access anomalies, Teams meeting forensics).

Validate CAP behaviors across platforms using test devices.

Work on ATO evidence packages and documentation.
End of Day
Update Jira tasks, Confluence documentation, and CR submissions.

Send status updates on active investigations, mitigations, and test results.
Required Qualifications
Technical Skills
Expert-level Intune engineering across Windows/macOS/iOS/iPadOS.

Advanced PowerShell for remediation, automation, and OS image manipulation.

Deep experience with Microsoft Defender (XDR, Endpoint, Cloud Apps).

Hands-on with Sentinel SIEM, Function Apps, and cross-platform telemetry pipelines.

Strong understanding of CAP architecture and identity risk enforcement.

Experience with ATO control evidence, compliance mapping, and audit support.
Soft Skills
Growth mindset and willingness to learn emerging security domains.

Strong cross-team collaboration (Cyber, Ops, EA, ICAM, Comms).

Excellent communication—clear summaries, user-impact translation, and documentation.

High reliability, ownership, and situational awareness during high-severity events.
Preferred Qualifications
Prior experience in federal security, high-compliance, or high‑assurance environments.

Experience with Jamf, Okta connectors, Copilot audit logging, Graph API operations.

Experience with mSCP baseline engineering and macOS security hardening.

Prior involvement in enterprise-wide Conditional Access enforcement.

Position Summary:

The Digital Workplace Engineer serves as a key enabler of productivity and collaboration, helping to ensure that productivity platforms, tools, and desktop computing environments are effectively delivered and aligned to business needs. The role works with business teams to understand processes and workflows, and is responsible for the management and administration for Graton's client computing environment, including maintaining standardized desktop images, application deployments, mobile device management (MDM) platforms, and specialty IT-supported devices such as door access control integrations, kiosks, and digital signage.

The position partners with IT support, systems, and other IT teams to provide guidance, documentation, and escalation support for deployments, configurations, device management, and productivity tools.

The ideal candidate brings strong technical depth in endpoint and device management along with the business facing analysis and communication skills to bridge end-user productivity and workflow needs with platform engineering.

Essential Functions:

1. Responsible for redefining hospitality at Graton Resort & Casino while living, supporting, and promoting our values.

2. Perform responsibilities in accordance with all Graton Resort & Casino standards, policies, and procedures.

3. Workplace Productivity Platforms & Tools

a. Analyze and document use cases for Microsoft 365, Microsoft Teams, and SharePoint to support effective adoption across business units and organizations.

b. Develop and deliver training materials and sessions for end users and IT support technicians on collaboration tools and workflows.

c. Support day-to-day configuration and troubleshooting of Teams and SharePoint sites; site design and custom development are out of scope for this role.

d. Serve as secondary/backup support for Microsoft 365 tenant administration, including user and license management, security groups, and basic tenant configuration, escalating complex issues to the primary M365 administration team.

e. Partner with the M365 administration team to stay current on tenant configuration changes relevant to backup coverage responsibilities.

4. Client Platform & Device Management

a. Build and maintain standardized PC images, configuration baselines, and related policies across the organization.

b. Package, test, and document deployment processes for images and client applications, ensuring compatibility, and optimal experience for end users.

c. Design and configure Mobile Device Management (MDM) policies and profiles, including enrollment, compliance policies, and update management

d. Collaborate and hand off day-to-day operations and device management and administration to IT Support and Asset Management.

e. Administer and maintain endpoint, device, and client-side components for IT-supported specialty systems such as digital signage, kiosks, printers, and physical access control technologies.

f. Review and maintain lifecycle and runbook documentation for client devices and specialty systems, including provisioning, decommissioning, and asset tracking.

g. Troubleshoot and resolve escalated client platform and device issues in partnership with IT Support and other IT teams.

5. Cross-Functional & Process Responsibilities

a. Maintain accurate technical documentation for imaging, MDM configurations, application packages, and specialty device administration.

b. Participate in change management and security review processes for client platform and device related changes.

c. Collaborate with other teams including Security, Facilities, and AV to support technical integrations, endpoint devices, and audit requirements related to physical access control and specialty systems.

d. Provide occasional after-hours or on-call support for critical client platforms, MDM, or access control issues.

6. This job description is not an exclusive or exhaustive list of all job functions that a team member in this position may be asked to perform from time to time. Duties and responsibilities may be changed, expanded, reduced, or delegated by Management to meet the business needs of the property.

Required Qualifications:

1. Ability to communicate effectively with Guests, Team Members and Management in both written and verbal form.

2. 3-5 years of experience in end user computing, desktop engineering, or client platform administration.

3. Strong knowledge of Microsoft 365, Teams, SharePoint, and Office productivity apps.

4. Hands-on experience with Microsoft Intune and/or SCCM for MDM and endpoint management.

5. Experience with PC imaging tools and processes, and application packaging/deployment.

6. Strong troubleshooting skills across Windows client environments, networking fundamentals, and device connectivity.

7. Excellent communication skills, with demonstrated ability to train and support both end users and technical staff.

Preferred Qualifications:

1. Exposure to Microsoft 365 tenant administration (Entra ID, Exchange Online, security groups, licensing).

2. Experience administering physical access control systems, kiosks, or other specialty/IoT-type IT supported devices.

3. Familiarity with ITIL practices and ITSM tooling (e.g., ServiceNow).

4. Experience in a hospitality, gaming, or other regulated/compliance-driven environment.

5. Relevant certifications (e.g., Microsoft Modern Desktop Administrator, MD-102, or equivalent).

Physical Requirements:

1. Manual dexterity to operate job related equipment.

2. Ability to lift up to 25 pounds, with or without assistance.

Age Requirement: 21 years of age or older

Pay Rate: Starting at $115,000 Annually

jobs.description:
ABOUT YOU
Are you the go-to problem solver when technology doesn’t cooperate? Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment where no two days are the same? Do you enjoy troubleshooting issues, optimizing systems, and creating a seamless experience for end users? If the answer is “Yes!” then we have an exciting opportunity for you. We are ARCO, a Family of Construction Companies.

We are seeking a proactive and service-oriented Desktop Administrator to support and enhance our Windows-based and cloud-connected environment. In this role, you will be responsible for managing end-user devices, supporting identity and access through Azure Active Directory, and ensuring devices remain secure and compliant using tools like Microsoft Intune.

WHAT WE CAN OFFER YOU
We are dedicated to the well-being of our associates and are proud to be consistently recognized as a Best Place to Work. Our compensation and benefits package not only supports our associates and their families but benefits local communities and communities around the world.

Industry-leading performance-based bonus program
Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP)
Traditional and Roth 401k
Tuition reimbursement for associates
Scholarship for associates’ children up to $28,000 per child
1-month paid sabbatical after every five years of employment, plus $5,000 for travel
1-week paid volunteer leave each year
100% charitable match
Medical, dental, and vision insurance coverage
100% paid 12-week maternity leave

At ARCO, our first core value is to treat people fairly and do the right thing. We are committed to building and sustaining a culture that supports diversity and inclusion. We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment.
From recruiting, training, and hiring practices to selecting our subcontractors, we understand that diversity of all those involved in the construction process enhances our ability to deliver the best solutions to our customers. We hire the best and the brightest from across the country - constructing a team of experts in architecture, design, engineering, project management, and business services.
A DAY IN THE LIFE
Endpoint Management & Administration

Serve as primary administrator of Microsoft Intune across a diverse device fleet including Windows 11 (physical and virtual), macOS, iOS, and Android
Manage device configuration policies, compliance baselines, and endpoint protection across both commercial and GCC High (secured) environments
Oversee application deployment, driver updates, and patching through Intune and Windows Update for Business
Maintain device provisioning policies and procedures via Microsoft Autopilot, supporting the full device lifecycle from provisioning through retirement

Identity & Policy Management

Manage device and group objects within Microsoft Entra ID
Administer Group Policy for on-premises environments while participating in the ongoing transition to cloud-native Intune policies for cloud-joined endpoints

Third-Party Platform Administration

Manage PatchMyPC for third-party application update deployment and quality assurance
Administer Apple Business Manager to streamline iOS device provisioning in the corporate environment
Maintain PrinterLogic for cloud-based printer driver deployment and configuration management; collaborate with the Support team and vendors on escalated printer and copier issues

Collaboration & Customer Experience

Act as the escalation point for the wider IT Support team on complex endpoint issues, providing timely communication around troubleshooting steps, workarounds, and ongoing issue status

Reporting & Documentation

Produce regular reporting on device compliance, patching metrics, end user experience, and inventory details using Microsoft Excel and Power BI
Maintain accurate, up-to-date documentation for systems, processes, and troubleshooting procedures

NECESSARY QUALIFICATIONS

2-5+ years of experience in endpoint administration and desktop support, with strong hands-on expertise in enterprise Windows 11 environments (2000+ devices)
Demonstrated experience administering Microsoft Intune, including device configuration, compliance policies, application deployment, and security baselines; Proficiency managing identities, devices, and groups within Microsoft Entra ID
Experience with Microsoft PowerShell to support remediations & application deployment for endpoints
Experience managing mobile endpoints across iOS and Android platforms, as well as supporting macOS devices
Working knowledge of Group Policy and traditional Active Directory environments; Familiarity with the Microsoft 365 ecosystem, including Exchange Online, Teams, and OneDrive
Understanding of core networking fundamentals including DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP, and VPN; Experience supporting and troubleshooting printer and copier environments
Proven ability to act as a technical escalation point for end-user support teams, with strong troubleshooting and communication skills
Ability to maintain clear documentation and effectively communicate technical information to both technical and non-technical audiences

MAKE YOUR MOVE
We are proud to be one of the fastest-growing, privately-owned companies in America, celebrating over 30 years of experience as design-build experts. We have completed over 6,550 design-build projects nationwide. We ranked #6 on ENR’s Design-Build Firms list and #29 on ENR's Top 400 Contractors list of 2025. Most importantly, our clients like us, trust us and want to do business with us. We are looking for people with the same enthusiasm, passion, and respect for the hard work that brought us to where we are today. Are you a person that can make a difference at ARCO? If the answer is, “Yes!” we look forward to meeting you.
ARCO does not accept unsolicited resumes from individual recruiters or third-party recruiting agencies without pre-approval from ARCO’s Human Resource team. Pre-approval is required before any external candidate can be submitted. ARCO will not be responsible for fees related to unsolicited resumes and for candidates who are sent directly to our hiring managers.
Agencies must have a fully executed vendor agreement in place as well as written approval to submit candidates from an ARCO TA Manager for a specific position before submitting candidates. LEGAL DISCLAIMER EOE, including disability/vets

Bachelor's Degree and 6+ years of relevant experience or an equivalent combination of education and years of experience.

Detailed knowledge of end user computing environments including Windows 10, Windows 11, Mac OSX, and their supporting infrastructure components such as Active Directory, group policy creation and maintenance, and SCCM

Experience with deploying, configuring, and managing enterprise solutions for Windows 10 and 11

Experience with Python, PowerShell, and Bash Scripting

Familiarity with VMware ESXi and VSphere.

Familiarity with virtualization network on multiple classifications.

Familiarity with Citrix or VMware VDI architecture.

Must be able to pass a federal background check.

Directly support CISA's critical mission to protect the nation's cyber and physical infrastructure within DHS.

Work alongside a team of skilled engineers, Tier 3/4 specialists, and federal stakeholders in a team-first environment.

Grow your federal IT career with access to professional development opportunities, certifications, and training support.

jobs.description:
Description

Leidos is seeking an experienced M365 Security and Compliance Administrator to join our Information Technology team. This role requires a seasoned professional who can strategically manage and enhance the security and compliance posture of the M365 environment within a GCC (Government Community Cloud) tenant, particularly in a federal agency context. This senior engineering role sits at the center of the organization’s device, identity, and M365 security ecosystem. The engineer is responsible for protecting enterprise Windows, macOS, iOS/iPadOS endpoints; ensuring compliant, reliable access to M365 services, and driving rapid engineering responses to vulnerabilities, outages, and operational risks. The successful candidate will apply with deep technical expertise, cross-platform engineering capability, and high operational security judgment.

Role Summary: Responsible for securing and maintaining compliance of the Microsoft 365 (M365) ecosystem and enterprise endpoints. Leads security governance, implements and enforces controls across M365, email, identity, devices, and telemetry, and provides incident response and audit/ATO support to ensure alignment with federal and organizational security requirements.

Primary Responsibilities

Strategic security oversight & governance

Lead the development, implementation, and ongoing management of M365 security policies, standards, and technical guardrails aligned to federal requirements and organizational controls.

Own governance for data protection capabilities including document classification, labeling, retention, and Data Loss Prevention (DLP) using Microsoft Purview.

Email security & compliance management (Exchange Online)

Define and enforce email security policies such as encryption, sensitivity labeling, and secure mail flow to reduce unauthorized disclosure.

Implement and maintain email encryption solutions (S/MIME and/or Microsoft Information Protection) to protect confidentiality of email communications.

Administer and monitor anti-spam, anti-phishing, and anti-malware protections to defend against evolving threats.

Identity, access, and conditional access (Entra ID)

Engineer and validate device-compliance–based Conditional Access policies across Windows, macOS, and mobile platforms.

Investigate and remediate Conditional Access failures, identity anomalies, and external/guest access issues, including M365 B2B trust and secure partner collaboration requirements.

Endpoint & device security engineering (Intune)

Design, test, and deploy Intune configuration and compliance policies for Windows, macOS, and iOS/iPadOS, including Enrollment Status Pages (ESPs) and OOBE workflows.

Develop remediation scripts (PowerShell/platform scripts/configuration profiles) to close compliance gaps and enforce security baselines.

Coordinate enterprise rollout of urgent vulnerability mitigations and validated vendor fixes; support vulnerability reviews and baseline rebuilds.

Risk management & compliance assurance (ATO / controls)

Establish and operate a risk management approach to identify, assess, and mitigate security risks across the M365 ecosystem.

Support ATO/control assessment activities by drafting implementation statements, collecting artifacts, and providing evidence aligned to audit/logging requirements.

Security monitoring, SIEM, and telemetry engineering (Defender / Sentinel)

Lead integration and operational management of Microsoft Defender and Microsoft Sentinel for threat detection, alerting, and response across M365.

Build and maintain SIEM integrations/connectors (e.g., M365, collaboration and identity systems) and develop ingestion pipelines (e.g., Azure Function Apps) for third-party logs.

Tune audit retention, analytic rules, and alert logic to improve signal quality and investigation readiness.

Incident response & operational support / collaboration

Provide Tier 3 troubleshooting for device compliance failures, identity/access incidents, telemetry gaps, and OS/app protection issues.

Partner with cross-functional teams to align security solutions with business objectives, deliver technical leadership, and support enterprise syncs and operational reviews.

Continuous improvement & innovation

Stay current on M365 security/compliance updates, industry trends, and emerging capabilities; drive improvements to security posture and operational efficiency (including use of GCC Copilot where appropriate).

Platform Scope / Tooling Microsoft 365 (GCC), Microsoft Purview (DLP/labels/classification/retention), Exchange Online, Entra ID & Conditional Access, Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Defender, Microsoft Sentinel, Azure (Function Apps / Log Analytics), plus integrations with collaboration/IT systems (e.g., ticketing and SaaS log sources).

“Day in the Life"

Morning

Review Sentinel incidents, Defender telemetry gaps, and compliance drift.

Respond to overnight CAP failures, Slack EMM issues, or OS update regressions.

Join device/enterprise standups.

Midday

Build/test remediation scripts (CVE fixes, NTLM disablement, compliance corrections).

Deploy or test Intune configuration profiles, ESP changes, or app protection updates.

Troubleshoot support cases with Microsoft (Purview DSPM, Copilot logs, Okta connector).

Afternoon

Conduct cross-team investigations (external-user access anomalies, Teams meeting forensics).

Validate CAP behaviors across platforms using test devices.

Work on ATO evidence packages and documentation.

End of Day

Update Jira tasks, Confluence documentation, and CR submissions.

Send status updates on active investigations, mitigations, and test results.

Required Qualifications

Technical Skills

Expert-level Intune engineering across Windows/macOS/iOS/iPadOS.

Advanced PowerShell for remediation, automation, and OS image manipulation.

Deep experience with Microsoft Defender (XDR, Endpoint, Cloud Apps).

Hands-on with Sentinel SIEM, Function Apps, and cross-platform telemetry pipelines.

Strong understanding of CAP architecture and identity risk enforcement.

Experience with ATO control evidence, compliance mapping, and audit support.

Soft Skills

Growth mindset and willingness to learn emerging security domains.

Strong cross-team collaboration (Cyber, Ops, EA, ICAM, Comms).

Excellent communication—clear summaries, user-impact translation, and documentation.

High reliability, ownership, and situational awareness during high-severity events.

Preferred Qualifications

Prior experience in federal security, high-compliance, or high‑assurance environments.

Experience with Jamf, Okta connectors, Copilot audit logging, Graph API operations.

Experience with mSCP baseline engineering and macOS security hardening.

Prior involvement in enterprise-wide Conditional Access enforcement.

We are seeking a highly skilled and customer-focused Professional Services Engineer to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will work closely with clients to understand their unique technical requirements, diagnose issues, and provide effective solutions. Your ability to dive into log files, troubleshoot complex problems, and debug issues will be essential in delivering exceptional consulting services. By leveraging your technical expertise and industry knowledge, you will ensure successful implementation, configuration, and integration of our product, while providing training and support to enable clients to maximize the value of our solution.
