jobs.summary: We're building safety-enhancing technology for aviation that will save lives. Automated aviation systems will enable a future where air transportation is safer, more convenient and fundamentally transformative to the way goods — and eventually people —...
jobs.description:
We're building safety-enhancing technology for aviation that will save lives. Automated aviation systems will enable a future where air transportation is safer, more convenient and fundamentally transformative to the way goods — and eventually people — move around the planet. We are a team of mission-driven engineers with experience across aerospace, robotics and self-driving cars working to make this future a reality.

As a Security Engineer working on our infrastructure, you will be a crucial part of our IT and Security team. Your work will improve and increase our hardening and defense of Reliable’s internal infrastructure. You will work closely with Client Platform engineers and the rest of the IT team to build and deploy our managed security tools. Efforts will involve client platform onboarding automation, reviewing cloud solutions and configurations and adapting them to our needs. You will focus heavily on securing the end-user experience by providing secure solutions.

ResponsibilitiesIn your role as Security Engineer you will be responsible for the design, implementation and monitoring of security tools supporting the business’ internal needs and safety requirements. You will be involved in securing daily drivers, as well as supporting development infrastructure for our products.

EDR and client security: Partnering with the client platform team, and working with affected users, you will be responsible for enforcing security configurations on all endpoints (macOS, Windows, iOS, Android) utilizing the appropriate tools for the job.

Identity and Access Management: Design and maintain manageable access control schemes, manage SaaS AAA and provide zero-trust designs (and implementations) for SSO.

Automation & Infra: Meet the automation requirements of the team by taking advantage of infrastructure as code systems in supported use, building reproducible solutions with adequate documentation to repair and manage those systems and being open to critique.

Incident Response and Ops work: Be able to perform Log Analysis, participate in threat hunting exercises and be capable of investigating security alerts from EDR or externally provided IOCs.

Collaboration and resilience: At Reliable we design robust systems for the purpose at hand that are easy to maintain. We demand the same level of collaboration and resiliency between our teams and our systems.

Basic Success Criteria5+ years of experience in an IT/Infrastructure Security, Security Operations (SecOps), or Corporate Infrastructure Security role.

Strong, fundamental understanding of endpoint operating systems (macOS and Windows 11) and how to securely configure them at scale via MDM platforms (e.g., Jamf, Intune, Kandji).

Deep understanding of SSL certificates, PKI infrastructure, and credential management.

Solid networking fundamentals and understanding of secure network architecture (VLAN segmentation, Zero Trust Network Access/ZTNA, Firewalls, WiFi security).

Scripting proficiency in languages such as Python, Bash, or PowerShell to automate security operations and log ingestion.

Experience with modern endpoint protection tools (EDR/XDR) and log management/SIEM platforms.

True Zero Technologies , a veteran-owned small business, was founded on the principle that the purposeful enablement of people and technology in an organization directly ties to the quality of its outcomes. True Zero recognizes that those outcomes begin and end with our people, and that is what we have built a community of like-minded, driven, and passionate individuals and innovators who are aligned in a common goal of delivering top-tier services to our customers. Our culture and commitment have been recognized through numerous accolades, including being named one of the Best Places to Work in 2023 in two categories (“Prosperous and Thriving” ($5MM–$50MM in gross revenue) and “Mid-Atlantic Region” (DC, DE, MD, NC, VA, WV)), and again in 2025 as a Best Places to Work honoree. In addition, True Zero earned coveted spots on the Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing companies in America in 2022, 2023, and 2025 , a testament to our sustained growth driven by our people-first approach and unwavering dedication to excellence.

The Endpoint Engineer – AI Desktop Deployment is responsible for designing, deploying, securing, and maintaining enterprise Windows endpoints that support AI-enabled desktop capabilities in highly regulated, government, and Zero Trust environments. This role combines traditional Windows desktop engineering with modern endpoint management, security compliance, application deployment, performance optimization, and device health monitoring.

The engineer will work closely with cybersecurity, cloud, identity, infrastructure, and application teams to ensure endpoints are secure, compliant, performant, and ready to support AI-enabled applications and workloads. The ideal candidate has strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Endpoint Manager, Windows 10/11, Group Policy, application packaging, and Zero Trust endpoint controls.

Job Responsibilities

- Perform enterprise desktop engineering for Windows 10 and Windows 11, including operating system configuration, deployment, lifecycle management, and troubleshooting.

- Administer and engineer Microsoft Intune / Microsoft Endpoint Manager environments for device enrollment, configuration, application deployment, compliance, and endpoint security.

- Design, implement, maintain, and troubleshoot Group Policy Objects (GPOs) supporting enterprise security, configuration, and operational requirements.

- Establish and maintain standardized Windows endpoint configurations, deployment methodologies, and engineering documentation.

- Develop and maintain Windows provisioning and deployment solutions, including Autopilot and automated device enrollment where applicable.

- Evaluate Windows updates, feature releases, drivers, firmware, and endpoint configuration changes before production deployment.

- Support endpoint modernization efforts and migration from legacy endpoint-management technologies to cloud-managed or hybrid-management architectures.

- Automate repetitive endpoint administration and configuration tasks using PowerShell and other approved scripting technologies.

Job Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline.

- Experience deploying Microsoft Copilot, AI assistants, or other enterprise AI desktop applications.

- Familiarity with enterprise AI governance, data-loss prevention, information protection, and access-control considerations for generative AI tools.

- Experience evaluating endpoint hardware and software readiness for AI-enabled workloads.

- Familiarity with Windows AI capabilities, AI-enabled productivity platforms, or locally executed AI workloads.

- Experience integrating endpoint-management telemetry with security, identity, IT operations, or SIEM platforms.

- Experience with Windows Autopilot, Microsoft Graph, PowerShell automation, or proactive remediation technologies.

Government Cloud & Zero Trust Responsibilities

- Implement and maintain device compliance and Conditional Access controls supporting the Zero Trust device pillar.

- Engineer, deploy, and maintain STIG-compliant endpoint security baselines for Windows systems.

- Apply and maintain DISA STIG, organizational security baseline, and applicable federal endpoint-hardening requirements.

- Configure Intune compliance policies, configuration profiles, endpoint security policies, and security baselines for government environments.

- Support endpoint-management capabilities within applicable Microsoft Government Cloud environments, including GCC, GCC High, or related environments as required.

- Integrate endpoint posture and device-compliance signals with identity and access-control solutions.

- Ensure only authorized, managed, compliant, and appropriately secured devices can access protected enterprise resources.

- Implement endpoint controls supporting Zero Trust principles including device identity, continuous verification, least privilege, and risk-based access.

- Coordinate with identity teams on Microsoft Entra ID device registration, join models, Conditional Access, and authentication requirements.

- Support Microsoft Defender for Endpoint or equivalent endpoint detection, security telemetry, vulnerability-management, and response capabilities.

- Remediate endpoint vulnerabilities, configuration findings, compliance exceptions, and security control deficiencies.

- Assist with evidence collection and technical documentation supporting security assessments, audits, authorization activities, and continuous monitoring.

- Support endpoint configurations aligned with applicable NIST, FISMA, FedRAMP, CISA, DoD, or agency-specific security requirements, as applicable to the environment.

Preferred Certifications:

- Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate (MD-102) — strongly desired.

- AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner — desired only if the position supports or integrates with AWS environments.

We’re actively searching for talented security and technology practitioners who are ready to experience the True Zero difference. As a True Zero team member, you'll enjoy:

- Competitive salary, paid twice per month

- Best in class medical coverage

- 100% of medical premiums covered by True Zero

- Company wide new business incentive programs

- Contribution Incentives (i.e. white papers, blog posts, internal webinars, etc.)

- 3 weeks of PTO starting + 11 Paid Holidays Annually

- 401k Program with 100% company match on the first 4%

- Monthly reimbursement of Cell Phone and Home Internet costs

- Paternity/Maternity Leave

- Investment in training and certifications to broaden and deepen your technical skills

This is a hands-on, customer-facing role supporting Microsoft Teams Rooms and modern hybrid collaboration technologies. The position requires strong technical depth, composure under pressure, and the ability to resolve issues in real time during business-critical meetings and events.

The ideal candidate operates independently, partners effectively across IT, Facilities, and vendors, and takes ownership of delivering a consistent, high-quality meeting experience across all locations.

Key Responsibilities

Workato delivers enterprise infrastructure for the agentic era, redefining iPaaS and helping enterprises unify data, applications, processes, and AI into a single, governed platform. A leader in Enterprise MCP and trusted by 50% of the Fortune 500, Workato’s cloud-native architecture connects every application, data source, and process to power real-time orchestration at scale. But, we also believe in balancing productivity with self-care. That’s why we offer all of our employees a vibrant and dynamic work environment along with a multitude of benefits they can enjoy inside and outside of their work lives.

Solid understanding of network security and cloud security best practices.Hands-on experience optimizing CI/CD workflows and automating deployments.Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.Nice to HaveExperience with Golang for tooling or internal services.Experience building cross-cloud AI infrastructure.Familiarity with Kafka, Redis, ClickHouse, PostgreSQL, or similar technologies.Experience with observability tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, or VictoriaMetrics.Understanding of Vault or other secrets management systems.Contributions to or maintenance of open-source infrastructure projects.

jobs.description:
Are you looking for a role where you're critical to every part of the business? Do you want to help ensure that our teams deliver software so that our analysts can deliver service to our customers? How about being a crucial part of making sure our internal teams operate efficiently?

You're not afraid of new technology. In fact, you love diving in and figuring out how it works. Whether it's a successful launch or a few bumps in the road, you're always up for a challenge. Balancing multiple projects at once is no easy feat, but when everything clicks into place, there's nothing quite like that sense of satisfaction.

The best part of the job? Seeing someone use a capability you've built and hearing them exclaim, "Wow, I can't believe how easy that was." You care about the success of your colleagues and take pride in helping them achieve it.

As a cloud-based IT organization, we're breaking the traditional mold and thinking creatively about how we can make the day-to-day life of our employees simple. We're always looking for innovative solutions, and we need someone with the wit and determination to help us achieve our goals.

In this role, you'll keep Expel's IT infrastructure and services secure and highly available, from our cloud platforms all the way down to the equipment in our conference rooms. You'll manage access across the employee lifecycle, own large cross-functional projects from beginning to end, and take manual work out of how we operate before anyone feels the friction. It's based onsite at our Herndon, Virginia headquarters, so you'll also be the person who makes sure the technology people walk up and touch works exactly like it should.

If you're up for the challenge, we want to hear from you!

* * *

### **What Expel Can Do For You**

- Provide the autonomy to define problems and propose solutions.
- Deliver never-ending opportunities to tackle business problems.
- Give you real ownership of large cross-functional projects, end to end.
- Surround you with a team of problem solvers.
- Ensure you get support, mentoring, and feedback to make you successful.

* * *

### **What You Can Do For Expel**

- Manage and maintain IT systems in a cloud first environment.
- Provide friendly and unflappable technical support.
- Make sure new hires have the accounts, access, and hardware they need on day one, and that access goes away promptly when people leave.
- Be the point of contact for the systems and services you own.
- Own large cross-functional projects from beginning to end.
- Collaborate with multi-functional teams to identify integration issues, solve errors, and optimize performance.
- Proactively find opportunities for improvement and build automations that streamline operations and reduce manual work.
- Apply AI tooling, like Claude and Gemini, to accelerate day-to-day work.
- Manage IT-owned technology at Expel's HQ, including network equipment, conference room and AV equipment, kiosk computers, and other shared-space systems.
- Keep people in the loop on service disruptions and changes.
- Work alongside our security team to protect our information.
- Contribute to the team's roadmap and work in two week sprints against quarterly and yearly goals.
- Build and routinely update documentation on automations, configurations, and operating procedures.

* * *

### **What You Should Bring With You**

- Proficiency managing core enterprise SaaS products such as Okta, Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, Jira, Confluence, and Microsoft 365.
- Experience automating tasks and integrating systems using platforms like Workato, Okta Workflows, or Microsoft Power Automate.
- Experience with AI platforms like Anthropic Claude and Google Gemini, including prompt engineering and connecting systems through emerging standards like the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
- Knowledge of concepts like SAML, OIDC, SCIM, REST APIs, webhooks, JWT, and OAuth 2.0.
- Knowledge of programming and scripting languages like Python, Bash, PowerShell, and Ruby.
- macOS and Windows operating system administration skills, including experience with MDMs like Jamf and Intune.
- Familiarity with conference room AV and shared-space technology, like Zoom Rooms and Neat devices.
- Knowledge of Cisco Meraki and basic networking concepts like VLANs, DNS, DHCP, and wireless networking.
- Strong project management skills, especially on large cross-functional projects.
- Capacity to balance a mix of urgent, interrupt-driven tasks and project-level work.
- Excellent customer service and communication skills, written and verbal, with a habit of treating colleagues like customers.
- Adept at translating technical concepts and communicating to non-technical audiences.
- Outstanding problem solving abilities, with a desire to get to the root of sophisticated issues.
- Well-versed in IT operations best practices.
- 5+ years of professional experience with IT, 2+ of which were in an engineering or sysadmin capacity.
- A college degree or credible panache.

* * *

### **Additional Notes**

This is an onsite, in-person role working out of our headquarters in Herndon, Virginia. Individuals must be located within the Washington D.C. metropolitan area.

The base salary range for this role is between $93,900 USD and $136,200 USD + bonus eligibility and equity. While the full salary band reflects our long-term compensation framework, we're primarily targeting candidates between $105,000 and $125,000 based on experience, skills, and market data.

You’ll also be eligible for unlimited PTO (which we model and encourage), work location flexibility, up to 24 weeks of parental leave, and really excellent health benefits.

We’re only hiring those authorized to work in the United States. We do not currently sponsor immigration visas.

We're an Equal Opportunity Employer: You'll receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability.

We’ll ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please let us know if you need accommodation of any kind.

#LI-Onsite

Salary Range

$93,900—$136,200 USD

About Gartner IT:
Join a world-class team of skilled engineers who build creative digital solutions to support our colleagues and clients. We make a broad organizational impact by delivering cutting-edge technology solutions that power Gartner. Gartner IT values its culture of nonstop innovation, an outcome-driven approach to success, and the notion that great ideas can come from anyone on the team.

About the role:
The Windows Endpoint team is looking for an engineer to help manage the Windows fleet including endpoint management, patching, administration and automation using technologies such as Intune, Configuration Manager, and PowerShell.

What you will do
Design, implement and maintain our Windows-based endpoint environment, including endpoint management, patch management, security management and deployment automation

Evaluate new technologies related to end user computing for use in the corporate enterprise to enable our knowledge workers

Develop standard work environments on company owned devices to ensure usability, performance and security requirements are maintained

Automate end user support activities to include packaging of software and scripting of support tasks

Automate service desk and desktop support tasks using various scripting languages (PowerShell)

jobs.description:
**The Basics:**

Advanced Consulting Engineers (ACEs) are post-sale product experts that communicate technical nuances to assist Tanium customers as they articulate their business objectives. A highly experienced technical resource, ACEs are engaged by Customer Success to handle extraordinary customer engagement issues (e.g., stalled adoption) at Enterprise and Major accounts and may beleveragedby the broader account team for short-term engagements to provideproduct-specific guidance for advanced use cases.

**What You'll Do:**

- **Business Objective Realization:** Play a crucial role in the customer journey to operationalize business objectives and provide value realization in complex or stalled adoption.
- **In-depth Knowledge Transfer:** Involved in enabling end-users to effectively use Tanium products, to get past stalled adoption.
- **Post-sales Technical Advisory:** Support and document technical setup and configuration of complex products into runbooks, due to stalled adoption from the customer. Able to provide onsite technical assistance for support issues causing adoption and/or churn risk.
- **Post-engagement Feedback:** Following the engagement, provide documented feedback to Product, Engineering, Enablement, and Customer Service Operations.

**We're Looking For:**

- **Education**
- Associates degree or equivalent experience required
- Bachelor degree in Computer Science, MIS, or similar experience a plus

- **Must Have**
- 8+ years in the industry with solid technical skills in multiple areas such as networking, security, operations, scripting, and/or programming.
- Experience in one or more of the following technical domains: Endpoint Security, Endpoint Support/Troubleshooting, Incident Response, Systems Management, Utility Scripting (bash, PowerShell, VBScript, Python).
- Extensive Hands-on Tanium experience
- Prior experience and breadth of knowledge needed to lead customers and internal teams.
- Has mastered many new concepts and technologies; continually striving to master the Tanium platform and modules.
- Critical thinking and problem solving; can break problems down into manageable, ordered piece parts and masterfully convey the problem statement and plan to others. Thinks critically, spanning the customer lifecycle, and develops new capabilities on the Tanium platform with a high level of autonomy.
- Good Judgement; takes self-governed, consistent, action to prioritize and weigh cost and value in order to determine the action most appropriately aligned with the Tanium and our mission.
- Independent; can work on the most complex problems; should be able to complete tasks that are not well documented; participate in projects specific to their current skills and follow established technical support procedures only requiring help on more complex initiatives or issues.
- Communication; have mastered executive communication and demonstrate emotional intelligence, and patience, in all forms of communication. Anticipate blockers and delays for their work and the work of others, and communicate appropriately before requiring escalation.
- Influencing; demonstrate strong and consistent influence skills, working effectively with their team and strategic customers, to present logical and compelling arguments to enhance innovation and efficiencies.
- Informal Leadership; constructively lead in recognizing when conditions have changed and the team needs to adapt. This requires an attitude and drive that also leads the team in spotting emerging trends and patterns quickly, solving hard problems, and generating creative solutions.
- A deep sense of ownership in the work, no matter how small the task. Willing to jump into any effort to help the team succeed.
- A reputation within, and outside of, their team for being highly collaborative. They use this thinking to actively mentor and coach others to aid in their professional achievement and help avoid problems/high-risk behavior.

**About Tanium**

Tanium is the Autonomous IT company. Driven by AI and real-time endpoint intelligence, Tanium Autonomous IT empowers IT and security teams to make their organizations unstoppable.

Many of the world’s leading organizations trust Tanium’s single, unified platform for endpoint management and security to innovate faster, stay resilient and move business forward with confidence, at scale. To learn how Tanium delivers Autonomous IT for unstoppable business – visit [www.tanium.com](http://www.tanium.com/) and follow us on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/tanium) and [X](https://twitter.com/Tanium).

**On a mission. Together.**

At Tanium, we are stewards of a culture that emphasizes the importance of collaboration, respect, and diversity. In our pursuit of revolutionizing the way some of the largest enterprises and governments in the world solve their most difficult IT challenges, we are strengthened by our unique perspectives and by our collective actions.

As a global organization with stakeholders around the world, it’s imperative that the diversity of our customers and communities is reflected internally in our team members. We strive to create a diverse and inclusive environment where everyone feels they have opportunities to succeed and grow because we know that only together can we do great things.

Our commitment to excellence and innovation has earned us a place on the Forbes Cloud 100 list for ten consecutive years, and we continue to be recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

Each of our team members has 5 days set aside as volunteer time off (VTO) to contribute to the communities they live in and give back to the causes they care about most.

**What you’ll get**

The annual base salary range for this full-time position is $150,000 to $230,000. This range is an estimate for what Tanium will pay a new hire. The actual annual base salary offered may be adjusted based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to, location, education, skills, training, and experience.

In addition to an annual base salary, team members will receive equity awards and a generous benefits package consisting of medical, dental and vision plan, family planning benefits, health savings account, flexible spending account, transportation savings account, 401(k) retirement savings plan with company match, life, accident and disability coverage, business travel accident insurance, employee assistance programs, disability insurance, and other well-being benefits.

jobs.description:
We are looking for an IT Architect Endpoint Management profile to join our IT team.

We are looking for an IT Architect Endpoint Management profile to join our IT team. The position provides advanced technical support to internal users across different countries and global regions, while also contributing to system administration and network operations to ensure stable and secure IT services.

Join us in shaping the future of IT security, developing secure and sustainable endpoint architectures, and actively contributing to making our digital workplace resilient and compliant. With us, you’ll have the freedom to contribute big ideas and take initiative. As part of an interdisciplinary and diverse team, you’ll apply your expertise in endpoint management to ambitious projects, help shape standards and roadmaps, and ensure that security and compliance requirements are reliably implemented in accordance with BSI-CON-11.1. We look forward to receiving your application for our office in Málaga.

Due to the international scope of the role, working hours are not fixed and may include evening, night, weekend, or rotating shifts, depending on the regions being supported.

Key responsibilities

- Developing and designing a highly secure endpoint management environment with clear target architectures and standards

- Leading endpoint management projects from planning through design to implementation, as well as actively participating in project teamwork

- Ensuring that security, compliance, and regulatory requirements (e.g., in accordance with guidelines from the Federal Office for Information Security, including BSI-CON-11.1) are met in the endpoint architectures

- Managing external service providers and coordinating the interfaces between IT security, infrastructure, and operations

- Evaluating and implementing new solutions and technologies in the endpoint environment to continuously improve the IT workstations

- Degree in computer science, business informatics, or a comparable qualification in the IT field

- At least 5 years of professional experience in endpoint management (operations and/or architecture) in medium-sized or large IT environments

- Good knowledge of common endpoint management tools, ideally such as Microsoft Intune and Tanium

- In-depth understanding of IT security, compliance, and regulatory requirements, preferably in regulated environments and in accordance with BSI guidelines

- A structured, independent work style, as well as strong communication and collaboration skills

- Willingness to undergo a security clearance screening in accordance with the Security Clearance Act (SÜG)

- A high level of English is required (C1)

- To ensure your work-life balance, we offer the option of mobile working

- We promote your professional and personal development through individually tailored student mentoring

- Make valuable contacts within Drees & Sommer and expand your professional network

- Modern workplace and equipment; Teams meetings and participation in corporate workshops

- Receive compensation that gives you financial independence during your studies

Creating a future worth living for future generations gets us out of bed every morning. Depending on the project, we are consultants, implementers, or both for sustainable, innovative and economical solutions for real estate, industry, energy and infrastructure. Our more than 6,500 employees at over 80 locations worldwide support our customers in interdisciplinary teams. Our thinking is both visionary and realistic. We work independently and as part of a team. With passion and the latest technologies. We unite. Join us at Dreso and let’s create a world we want to live in.

Product Senior Manager, Endpoint Security

Capital One is seeking a technical security product leader to deliver game-changing cybersecurity solutions based on threat, data, and design thinking. At Capital One, we believe in the values of Excellence and Doing the Right Thing. We are a technology-oriented company delivering financial products to market through modern technology and constant innovation at a massive scale. That innovation includes leveraging technology to deliver the best cybersecurity solutions for our internal and external customers.

As a candidate for Endpoint Security Product role, you’re able to seamlessly switch from executive-level risk conversations to diving deep into controls and technology to driving high level, strategic discussions around roadmaps and security solutions. You are naturally curious and stay on top of emerging trends and threats. You are not afraid to question any existing processes and solutions, yet you display a keen sense of business value proposition and focus on the right priorities. You are a clear thinker, thrive in working across teams, and an expert in dealing with ambiguity. You believe that a core component of security’s role is to enable the business, not just to secure it, and the solutions you bring to life are aligned to the needs of our engineering community and business partners. You thrive in working in a fast paced, technologically forward leaning environment and are not afraid to push the boundaries of security capabilities.

What you'll do:

Develop and communicate a risk-based and data-driven strategy and outcome-driven roadmaps for enterprise security services, solutions, and capabilities, in partnership with engineering and operations partners, customers, and other stakeholders

Analyze and select alternatives based on threat, risk, desirability, feasibility, and viability

Keep abreast of advances in industry to address the threat landscape

Advise executive decision makers based on business and technology risk grounded in threat

Facilitate build vs. buy decisions to identify optimal strategies for addressing business and technology risks

Develop and lead RFI/RFPs to assess the market and/or procure effective cyber solutions

Maintain technical and risk credibility with your own team and with partners across the enterprise

Maintain close ties to various stakeholders, developers, and engineers across the company, ensuring the services we create meet their needs as products evolve

Iterate quickly and see the products through to production and scale

Establish product value propositions, metrics, and key indicators

Recruit, motivate, mentor, and lead those around you to be their best

About You...

You have strong consulting and analytical skills

You have the ability to foster collaborative, open, working relationships with technology groups and other stakeholders, including vendor relationships

You have demonstrated clear communication skills and ability to interact effectively at all levels of an organization, and to influence senior management and executives (Including translating technical information based on specific audiences)

You have experience managing multiple high-visibility and high-impact enterprise cybersecurity projects with cross-functional teams while maintaining superior results including planning, development and management of technical requirements, design, testing and deployment of security solutions

You have a passion for cybersecurity.

High School Diploma, GED or equivalent certification

At least 6 years of experience working in cybersecurity or information technology

At least 3 years of experience translating cybersecurity strategy and analysis into product requirements

Preferred Qualifications:

Bachelor's Degree in Cybersecurity, Systems Engineering, or Computer Science

7+ years of experience solving cyber technical challenges

7+ years of experience translating business strategy and analysis into products

4+ years of Cyber product owner experience

2+ years of experience in technical writing

Experience in regulated financial services organizations or tech companies

2 or more professional certifications: SAFe, PMP, CSPO, CISSP, GIAC, CISM, CCSP, AWS Security, AWS Advanced Networking Specialty, or AWS Solutions Architect

Deep expertise in endpoint security domains, including telemetry-driven detection and response, forensics, insider threat, ecosystem security, malware protection, and endpoint control frameworks such as allowlisting or device governance.

Strong understanding of endpoint security architectures and systems, including endpoint agents, telemetry pipelines, detection workflows, and integration with SIEM or XDR platforms.

Experience leading end-to-end product lifecycle for endpoint security capabilities including evaluation, vendor selection, onboarding, and enterprise-scale rollout in partnership with third-party, engineering, architecture, ISO, and risk teams.

Experience with developer security ecosystem including IDE security, AI-powered development tools governance, and modern software supply-chain security controls.

Experience translating regulatory requirements such as SOX, PCI, or SOC into actionable endpoint security product requirements and control frameworks, with ability to balance compliance requirements with business enablement.

As champions of internal mobility and access to opportunity, we encourage our people to “go for it” and equip our managers with the training to coach their teams to the next level. We strive to provide employees a safe space to network, share ideas and create opportunities.

PLEASE NOTE: To support strong partnership and team connection, this role follows a four day in office work model.

While the internal title for this position is Senior Linux Engineer, this role has been posted externally under a different title to better align with market norms and to attract talent with comparable experience and skill sets.

Role Overview

We are seeking a Senior Linux Platform Engineer to join our Systems Platform Engineer team. In this role, you will be responsible for managing and improving our highly automated Linux-based systems and platforms while supporting our broader technology infrastructure with a focus on automation. You'll be working collaboratively with our technology and operations teams to ensure the highest levels of system performance, security, and availability.

Your responsibilities will be:

Managing and improving our Linux-based infrastructure with a focus on performance, reliability, and scalability. Designing, deploying, and maintaining on-premises Kubernetes clusters and containerized workloads. Developing and maintaining system-level software, middleware, and APIs to support internal platforms and services. Automating system workflows and infrastructure tasks using Python, Bash, and configuration management tools like SaltStack. Building and maintaining RPM packages and internal software repositories. Collaborating with Application Support (SRE), Development, and Security teams to ensure secure, automated CI/CD and platform integration. Diagnosing and resolving complex system-level issues involving the OS, network, or container runtime. Implementing hardened security configurations, including system hardening, secure communications, and identity/access integration. Participating in an on-call rotation to support critical infrastructure services. Documenting architectures, tools, and operational processes to support long-term maintainability.

The ideal candidate has

5+ years of experience in Linux systems administration and infrastructure/platform engineering. Production experience managing Kubernetes, preferably in bare-metal or on-premises environments (e.g., with kubeadm, RKE, or OpenShift). Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure or GCP) in production environments.Strong scripting and automation skills in Python and Bash. In-depth knowledge of Linux internals, kernel tuning, and performance diagnostics. Hands-on experience with SaltStack (preferred), Puppet, or Ansible for configuration management. Familiarity with observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, or Loki. Solid understanding of core infrastructure protocols and services (TCP/IP, DNS, NTP/PTP, DHCP, etc.). Experience managing CI/CD pipelines with tools such as Jenkins, GitLab, or similar. Strong troubleshooting skills and a proactive approach to problem-solving.

You'll really stand out with:

Certifications such as RHCE or LFCE. Experience with container runtimes (containerd, Docker) and registry management. Knowledge of GitOps workflows or tools like ArgoCD or Flux. Background in security best practices and compliance (e.g., CIS benchmarks, STIGs). Prior experience in highly regulated or low-latency environments.

Benefits And Perks Of Working For Cboe Global Markets

We value the total wellbeing of our people – including health, financial, personal and social wellness. We believe standard benefits like health insurance and fair pay are a given at any organization. Still, you should know we offer:

Fair and competitive salary and incentive compensation packages with an upside for overachievement Generous paid time off, including vacation, personal days, sick days and annual community service days Health, dental and vision benefits, including access to telemedicine and mental health services 2:1 401(k) match, up to 8% match immediately upon hire Discounted Employee Stock Purchase Plan Tax Savings Accounts for health, dependent and transportation Employee referral bonus program Volunteer opportunities to help you give back to your communities

Complimentary lunch, snacks and coffee in any Cboe office Paid Tuition assistance and education opportunities Generous charitable giving company match Paid parental leave and fertility benefits On-site gyms and discounts to other fitness centers Paid Time Off

We work with purpose, solving problems with ingenuity, collaboration, and a lot of passion. We’re an engaged and excited team connecting markets across borders and embracing growth in all its forms to achieve incredible outcomes.

jobs.summary: #### **The Basics:** Tanium's Product Management team is actively seeking a **Director, Product Management** to lead **Policy and Configuration Management for the Endpoint Management portfolio**. This is a senior individual contributor role responsible...
jobs.description:
#### **The Basics:**

Tanium's Product Management team is actively seeking a **Director, Product Management** to lead **Policy and Configuration Management for the Endpoint Management portfolio**. This is a senior individual contributor role responsible for owning the strategy, roadmap, and execution of how Tanium defines, applies, and proves configuration state across the enterprise — giving IT and Security teams a single way to set policy once and enforce it consistently across Windows, Linux, and macOS endpoints, regardless of whether those endpoints are on-premises, remote, or in the cloud.

The successful candidate will own the product strategy behind Tanium's centralized policy engine: application allow/deny control, full-disk encryption, device and removable media control, host firewall management, and machine- and user-scoped administrative template (Group Policy-style) policy. This includes the migration tooling that lets customers import existing Group Policy backups and industry hardening standards — such as CIS Build Kits and vendor security baselines — directly into managed policy. You will also shape the next generation of policy types that supersede legacy mechanisms as customers modernize off traditional, on-premises group policy infrastructure.

You will work cross-functionally with Engineering, Product Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success to set vision, drive roadmap, ship capabilities customers trust for compliance and audit, and turn consistent configuration state into measurable risk reduction for customers.

A successful candidate is a strong communicator and influencer who can operate fluently across executive stakeholder conversations, deep technical architecture discussions, and customer-facing storytelling. Must have a successful track record of shipping enterprise configuration management, compliance, or policy products at scale.

#### What you'll do

- Own the **product strategy, roadmap, and delivery** for Tanium's endpoint policy and configuration management capabilities, end to end from ideation to launch.
- Drive the roadmap for **Windows policy and configuration management** — application control (allow/deny rules), full-disk encryption, device and removable storage control, host firewall management, and machine- and user-scoped administrative template policy — ensuring parity with and differentiation from traditional Group Policy infrastructure.
- Expand **Linux configuration management** capabilities (e.g., host firewall management and hardening controls), building out coverage on top of an established Windows foundation.
- Own the strategy for **legacy migration and baseline import tooling** — Group Policy backup import and industry hardening standard support (CIS Build Kits, vendor security baselines) that automatically convert a downloaded benchmark file into a ready-to-enforce compliance policy, complete with conflict detection across overlapping settings and automatic content-set mapping — and for next-generation policy types that supersede legacy equivalents as customers modernize.
- Define and evolve **policy enforcement state and compliance reporting** (applied, partially applied, superseded, not applied) so customers can prove configuration compliance and audit posture at any time.
- Partner with incident response, reporting, and guidance capabilities across the platform to turn security findings into durable preventive policy and to surface actionable configuration drift and remediation guidance to operators.
- Document customer use cases, product requirements, and business justifications for new policy and configuration investments; prioritize ruthlessly based on customer risk reduction, compliance mandates, and platform leverage.
- Partner with Product Marketing and Sales to develop **go-to-market motions, enablement, and messaging**; support launches, analyst engagements, and customer briefings.
- Cultivate **strategic customer relationships** to validate direction, surface gaps, and turn lighthouse deployments into reference architectures.
- Establish and track KPIs — policy adoption, time-to-compliance, configuration drift and remediation rates, and platform pull-through — and use them to drive continuous improvement.
- Leverage emerging trends in **agentic AI and autonomous IT** to shape the roadmap for self-healing, continuously enforced endpoint configuration.

#### Requirements

#### Education

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
- Masters in Computer Science or MBA preferred.

#### Experience

- **8+ years** of total professional experience in enterprise B2B software, with at least **5 years in product management** supporting a SaaS or enterprise platform.
- **Required:** hands-on experience with **Windows policy and configuration management** — Group Policy, ADMX administrative templates, security baselines, full-disk encryption, application control, or comparable endpoint configuration tooling.
- **Strong bonus:** in-depth experience with **Linux configuration management** — configuration/hardening frameworks, host firewall management, or compliance baselines for Linux systems.
- Demonstrated success **owning and shipping policy, compliance, or configuration management products** at enterprise scale.
- Deep familiarity with **endpoint management and IT operations** — including the customer workflows that span IT and Security teams.
- Strong fluency with **compliance frameworks and industry baselines** (e.g., CIS benchmarks, vendor security baselines) and how they translate into enforceable policy.
- Experience working with **executive stakeholders** to align on vision, secure investment, and unblock execution.
- Proven ability to drive cross-functional alignment across engineering, marketing, and sales without direct authority.

#### Other

- Align with the Tanium values: **we win as a team, we do the right thing, and we are unstoppable**.
- Intuition to identify high-leverage configuration and compliance gaps that align with Tanium's platform and present opportunities for rapid growth.
- Willingness to take on firmly-entrenched, legacy configuration management incumbents with creative approaches to technology and a tenacious pursuit to build and grow a product's customer base.
- Ability to establish and nurture strong customer champions who can serve as advocates and an informal advisory board.
- Strong written communication, verbal communication, and executive presentation skills.

Job Description An exciting career awaits you

At MPC, we re committed to being a great place to work one that welcomes new ideas, encourages diverse perspectives, develops our people, and fosters a collaborative team environment.

Position Summary

The Senior Platforms Engineer is responsible for the strategic design, deployment, and optimization of complex infrastructure platforms and systems, ensuring high availability, scalability, and security. This qualified candidate will have proven experience as a technical lead or platform owner for digital workplace or AI initiatives.

This role will maintain ownership throughout the entire lifecycle of AI agents and automation, handling intake, governance, versioning, monitoring, and retirement in production environments. An expected focus of this role is to deliver impactful AI value and usage reports, presenting productivity improvements, risk assessments, and cost optimization metrics to leadership and business stakeholders.

This role leads advanced troubleshooting, performance tuning, and technical support activities, serving as the primary escalation point for complex issues and collaborating across teams to drive continuous improvement. The Senior Platforms Engineer also oversees resiliency, disaster recovery and backup strategies, develops comprehensive reporting frameworks, and ensures compliance with industry standards and best practices.

The candidate will have designed and implemented secure, enterprise-grade low-code applications for regulated and sensitive data, ensuring compliance and robust protection measures.

Additionally, this position fosters a culture of knowledge sharing by mentoring junior engineers, organizing training sessions, and promoting cross-functional collaboration to enhance documentation and information sharing.

This position belongs to a family of jobs with increasing responsibility, competency, and skill level. Actual position title and pay grade will be based on the selected candidate s experience and qualifications.

Key Responsibilities

Identifies performance bottlenecks, conducts root cause analysis, and proposes and implements solutions to enhance platform & system performance and resource utilization. Establishes performance benchmarks, conducts capacity planning, and collaborates with other teams, including junior engineers and cross functional teams to optimize infrastructure performance and activities.
Contributes to the development and improvement of troubleshooting procedures, measures to minimize platform & system downtime, and documentation. Partners with technical support to drive for resolution. Leads and manages platform & system technical support activities and troubleshooting efforts, including handling escalated and complex issues. Performs advanced system tuning and optimization to maximize performance using IT Service Management practices. Collaborates with Systems and Solution Architects, Governance, Regulatory and Compliance as well as other organizational teams to enhance support processes and methodologies.
Participates in future platform & system backup planning. Leads the design of disaster/system recovery and testing.
Analyzes Power Platform, Copilot Studio, AI agent, and digital workplace platform performance and utilization data to identify trends and patterns. Provides recommendations for optimization, cost efficiency, reliability, and value realization. Prepares executive ready reporting and drives corrective actions to continuously improve platform and AI service outcomes.
Leads development of advanced troubleshooting procedures and operational runbooks for Power Platform solutions, AI agents, and automations. Serves as the primary escalation point for complex platform, automation, or agent issues. Coordinates with vendors and internal teams to resolve incidents and continuously improve service reliability and operational maturity.
Leads the creation and maintenance of a comprehensive knowledge base for platforms & systems, including troubleshooting guides, configuration documentation, and best practices. Promotes knowledge sharing culture by organizing training sessions, mentoring junior engineers, and encouraging cross-team collaboration.

Education and Experience

Bachelor s Degree in Information Technology, related field or equivalent experience required
Five (5) or more years of relevant experience required.

Administered and supported Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, Copilot Agents, Azure Services) in enterprise environments highly preferred.
Experience applying automation design patterns, managed error handling, monitoring, and provided operational support for platforms highly preferred.
Developed and delivered platform usage, reliability, and adoption reporting for leadership and stakeholders preferred.
Implemented environment strategies, solution packaging, and application lifecycle management practices for low-code platforms preferred.
Managed security, identity, and access controls within Microsoft 365 and Power Platform preferred.

Skills

Cloud Infrastructure Management - Setting up, configuring, monitoring, and optimizing the components of cloud infrastructure.
Computer Networking - A system in which multiple computers are connected to each other to share information and resources.
Cybersecurity Risk Management - The process of developing cyber risk assessment and treatment techniques that can effectively pre-empt and identify significant security loopholes and weaknesses, demonstrating the business risks associated with these loopholes and providing risk treatment and prioritization strategies to effectively address the cyber-related risks, threats and vulnerabilities, ensuring appropriate levels of protection, confidentiality, integrity and privacy in alignment with the security framework.
DevSecOps - A set of practices that automates the integration of security at every phase of the software development lifecycle, from initial design through integration, testing, deployment, and software delivery, with an aim towards shortening the systems development life cycle and pas well as continuous delivery and a security first approach.
General Programming - Applies a computer language to communicate with computers using a set of instructions and to automate the execution of tasks.
Infrastructure as Code (IaC) - The process of managing and provisioning infrastructure through code instead of through manual processes.
IT Infrastructure Management - Planning, design, delivery and control of information technology infrastructure.
Performance Monitoring - The process of measuring the performance of a system in real time in order to determine problems and identify other factors that may cause problems in the future.
Policy Management - The process of creating, implementing and maintaining policies and procedures within an organization.
Process Automation - Also known as business automation or digital transformation, this is the technology-enabled automation of complex business processes. It can streamline a business for simplicity, achieve digital transformation, increase service quality, improve service delivery or contain costs. It consists of integrating applications, restructuring labor resources and using software applications throughout the organization.
Service Delivery Management - The manner in which an organization provides users access to IT services, which include applications, data storage and other business resources.
Systems Administration - Performs a variety of functions including user management, system monitoring, system configuration, performance tuning, backup and recovery, and access control.
System Platform- A system platform refers to the underlying foundation or framework that supports and manages the operation of software applications and hardware components within a computing environment. It provides a standardized and cohesive infrastructure, allowing for the development, deployment, and integration of various technologies and services.
Systems Testing - The process of testing conducted on a complete integrated system to evaluate the system's compliance with its specified requirements.
Systems Integration - The process of linking together various IT systems, services and/or software to enable all of them to work functionally together.
Troubleshooting - The act or process of discovering and resolving problems, disputes, or mechanical issues through a systematic, usually iterative, approach.
AI Platform Reliability &
• Incident Management Operating AI agents and automation platforms in production, including incident response, root cause analysis, and post incident remediation.

Enterprise ALM &
• Release Management Managing solution promotion, version control, and coordinated releases for low code and AI solutions across environments.

Data Integration &
• Connector Strategy Integrating Power Platform and AI solutions with enterprise systems, APIs, and data sources while managing connector risk and performance.

Identity, Access &
• Permissions Modeling Designing and enforcing role based access, service accounts, managed identities, and secure permission models.

Cost Awareness &
• Optimization (FinOps) Monitoring usage patterns and identifying optimization opportunities for AI, automation, and platform services.

Platform Standardization &
• Pattern Development Defining reusable patterns, reference architectures, and templates for AI agents, workflows, and low code applications.

Change Management &
• Adoption Enablement Supporting rollout, operational readiness, and adoption of AI enabled digital workplace capabilities.

Vendor &
• Third Party Platform Coordination Partnering with vendors to resolve issues, influence roadmaps, and evaluate emerging capabilities.

Risk Assessment &
• Compliance Alignment Assessing AI and platform solutions against security, privacy, regulatory, and audit requirements.

Technical Communication &
• Executive Readouts Translating platform and AI operational data into clear, decision ready insights for leadership.

Overview

Our Client is seeking a Senior Windows Endpoint Consultant to provide hands-on expertise supporting Windows workstation performance across the enterprise and its business units.

Following the deployment of several new security agents across the Windows environment, teams have experienced workstation and laptop performance challenges. This consultant will serve as a senior technical resource to help quickly diagnose the underlying causes, identify gaps or configuration issues, and recommend and implement improvements.

The initial focus will be Windows laptop performance and optimization, with the potential to support additional endpoint and Microsoft-focused initiatives as needs evolve.

Key Responsibilities

Required Experience

Deep hands-on expertise with Microsoft Windows workstation/endpoint environments, particularly Windows 10/11.Strong experience with Windows imaging, application packaging, deployment, and endpoint management tooling.Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex Windows performance issues at the operating system and endpoint level.Experience diagnosing conflicts or performance degradation involving endpoint security agents, EDR tools, antivirus, DLP, or other security software.Strong understanding of Windows processes, services, drivers, policies, startup behavior, resource utilization, and system performance.Experience supporting Windows endpoints in a large, complex enterprise environment.Ability to perform detailed root-cause analysis rather than simply treating symptoms.Strong communication skills and ability to work across Security, Infrastructure, Engineering, and business technology teams.Comfortable operating as a highly hands-on senior consultant with limited oversight.Must be local to the Chicagoland area and able to work onsite in Rosemont, IL multiple days per week.

jobs.description:
CMT is looking for a highly motivated and collaborative IT Security Engineer to join the CMT team. Reporting to the leader of IT Engineering, you will work in a highly collaborative role mostly focused on the execution of assigned tasks relating to information technology security, infrastructure, and IT managed cloud solutions. This role will also serve as a Tier-3 escalation point for our internal Help Desk. This is a highly collaborative role, and communication skills are critical. This is a hybrid role that requires in-office presence at CMT’s Budapest, Hungary, office at least 3 days per week, or as the work demands.

CMT is looking for a **Senior IT Security Engineer** to help us change the world. CMT has helped protect over 65 million drivers and prevent over 126,000 crashes worldwide. We build AI to solve some of the most difficult challenges in mobility — understanding and reducing risk, detecting crashes, and getting people life-saving help. The problems are hard. The impact is real. No matter your role, your work will matter at CMT.

**Responsibilities:**

- Using independent judgment, execute assigned tasks in an efficient and effective manner
- Collaborate with colleagues to implement and update IT processes and infrastructure
- Design and implement solutions and controls that support adherence to CMT policy
- Proactively investigate and remediate emerging vulnerabilities impacting endpoints and Saas tools
- Apply established security frameworks to IT processes and infrastructure, ensuring configurations and workflows align with CMT policies
- Understand security governance control and implement best practices in IT-controlled environments (SaaS, email security, IdP, etc.)
- Collaborate with security stakeholders and other IT personnel on security-related projects
- Perform regular security audits on IT systems with little to no supervision
- Provide incident support when needed, which includes, but is not limited to, response, containment, remediation, and go-forward activities
- Participate in tabletop exercises when needed
- Respond to security detections, reviewing alerts for false positives or providing next steps for remediation
- Advanced understanding of Datadog’s product and technology, including advanced queries and alert configuration
- In-depth knowledge of Jamf’s Security Cloud offering
- Research, recommend, and implement new technologies and features
- Apply scripting and code development knowledge to identify security risks within code artifacts, scripts, and packages as needed
- Collaborate with leadership in documenting and continuously improving IT security policies, procedures, and incident response processes
- Complete any additional tasks as they arise

**Qualifications:**

- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent years of experience and/or certification in a related field
- 4+ years of experience with macOS, iOS/iPadOS, and Windows management in an enterprise environment in a security role
- 4+ years of relevant working experience in IT Security
- Understanding of common cloud provider ideologies
- Excellent verbal and communication skills
- Excellent written and spoken English skills

**Nice to Haves:**

- Practical experience executing security-centric tasks
- Experience with, AWS management, Tableau, OneLogin, Sophos, and G-Suite preferred
- CompTIA Security+
- Jamf 200+ Certification
- (ISC)2 CISSP, CCSP, or SSCP

**Compensation and Benefits:**

- Fair and competitive salary based on skills and experience
- Equity may be awarded in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)
- Private healthcare
- Life and disability insurance
- Parental leave
- Flexible scheduling and work from home policy depending on role and responsibilities

**Base Salary Range**

- The base salary range for this position is: 19,234,100 to 24,042,600 HUF. This range is specifically for Budapest, Hungary.

**A** **dditional Perks:**

- Work on a mission with real impact: crashes prevented, injuries avoided, lives protected around the world
- Join an industry leader — 65+ million drivers protected, powering 140+ programs across 25 countries
- Recognized innovator in mobility AI, earning top honors including the TIME Industry Leader in AI, a Gold Edison Award, and the Artificial Intelligence Excellence Award for AI for Social Good. CMT is also Great Place to Work Certified
- Be part of the team inventing the future of mobility and road safety
- Move fast, own outcomes, do work that matters
- High ownership, small teams, and direct access to leadership — no layers between your work and its impact
- Summer Fridays provide team members with half days to recharge
- Join one of our employee resource groups: Black, AAPI, LGBTQIA+, Women, Book Club, and Health & Wellness
- Comprehensive wellness, education, and employee assistance programs

**Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion:**

At CMT, we believe the best ideas come from a mix of backgrounds and perspectives.

We are an equal-opportunity employer committed to creating a workplace and culture where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to bring their unique talents and perspectives. Diversity is essential to our success, and we actively seek candidates from all backgrounds to join our growing team.

We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status or disability state. CMT is headquartered in Cambridge, MA. To learn more, visit www.cmtelematics.com and follow us on Instagram @cmt.ai

**A** **bout Cambridge Mobile Telematics:**

Cambridge Mobile Telematics (CMT) is the world’s largest telematics and AI company for safer mobility. Its mission is to make the world’s roads and drivers safer. The company’s AI-driven platform, DriveWell Fusion®, proactively identifies and reduces driving risk, leading to fewer crashes and injuries. To date,

CMT’s technology has helped prevent over 126,000 crashes worldwide. CMT enables partners to measure risk, detect crashes, provide life-saving assistance, and streamline claims. Headquartered in Cambridge, MA, CMT operates globally with offices in Budapest, Hungary; Chennai, India; Seattle, Washington; Tokyo, Japan; and Zagreb, Croatia. Learn more at www.cmt.ai.

jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

IT SYSTEMS ADMINISTRATOR, LAUNCH

SpaceX is looking for a highly skilled and knowledgeable IT Systems Administrator to support the networking, compute administration, and application support needs of our launch environment. This role will be pivotal to the enablement of safe and sustained launch cadence, directly supporting our goals of making humanity a multiplanetary species. Candidate must be comfortable working on mission-critical systems with a sense of urgency appropriate to the responsibilities while maintaining attention to detail and operational excellence.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Augment and deploy new IT infrastructure, including networking, server, and desktop hardware directly supporting mission critical networks across the country.

- Perform periodic systems upgrades and patches in between critical operations, sometimes on weekends and evenings.

- Monitor IT services and respond aggressively to incidents to maintain systems performance.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to proactively identify and resolve potential technical issues with systems deployments.

- Author and maintain documentation for IT systems, from systems overview documents and design drawings to procedures.

- Leverage automation tools and contribute to IT systems engineering efforts.

- Ensure that systems are configured and maintained in compliance with industry and cybersecurity standards (e.g. ITAR, ISO, NIST).

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

- High school diploma or equivalency certificate.

- 3+ years of experience in IT systems administration.

- Hands-on experience with Linux or Windows server administration.

- Experience with enterprise network administration and deployment.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

- Working knowledge of network protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, SNMP, NTP, PTP etc), firewalls administration and cybersecurity technologies.

- Proficiency in scripting (Bash/Powershell/Python) and automation frameworks (Terraform, Ansible, Puppet).

- Familiarity with Active Directory and multi-platform authentication/identification environments.

- Experience with virtualization platforms and tools.

- Understanding of Layer 1 configuration best practices and multiplexing technologies.

- Working knowledge, including the ability to setup, configure, upgrade, manage, and troubleshoot, Windows-based systems and services (i.e. SCCM, Active Directory).

- Exposure to real-time systems and industrial telemetry networks.

- Experience with configuration management, provisioning, infrastructure as code, and other DevOps concepts and tools.

- Excellent communications skills with the ability to communicate with internal/external customers, vendors, management etc. in both formal and informal situations.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

- Ability to pass Air Force background checks for Cape Canaveral and Vandenberg.

- Must have valid driver's license.

- Willing to work extended hours or weekends as necessary.

- Willing to be on after-hours on-call rotation.

- Ability to lift up to 30lbs.

- Ability to work at heights.

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

- To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here .

SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to EEOCompliance@spacex.com .

jobs.description:
About the Role

We’re seeking a sharp, trusted, and highly autonomous Enterprise Solutions Engineer, Channel to help drive NinjaOne’s expansion into the enterprise market. This is a builder role—your chance to shape how we engage complex accounts, scale technical wins, and define what great looks like in enterprise pre-sales. You’ll own the full technical sales cycle—from discovery and architecture through proof-of-concept and implementation—while partnering closely with AEs to influence deal strategy and deliver real-world impact. You won’t just run demos—you’ll build the playbooks, tools, and repeatable processes that help us scale. If you’ve done this before in B2B SaaS, thrive in high-stakes environments, and want your work to directly shape the next chapter of NinjaOne’s growth, we’d love to hear from you.

Location - We are flexible on remote working from home, if you are located in the USA and reside in one of the following states - CT, FL, GA, ME, MA, NJ, NC, NY, OH, TN, & VA.
Travel Requirements - ~50%, including strategic customer meetings, industry events, and team collaboration

What You’ll Be Doing

Own the full pre-sales technical experience for Enterprise Partners, Channel, MSPs & Customers. This will include product demonstrations, architecture design, and key customer engagements to drive deal success. Represent NinjaOne at enterprise-facing industry events, conferences, and customer forums.Support the review and alignment of technical content within RFPs and RFIs without owning full proposal management.Partner with Training and Customer Success teams to accelerate time-to-value and ensure long-term adoption success.Serve as a strategic voice between Sales and Product—surfacing feedback, identifying feature gaps, and influencing roadmap direction.Build and maintain reusable technical assets including lab environments, demo flows, battlecards, and scripts to support a scalable AE-to-SE model.Collaborate closely with Account Executives and Sales Leadership to drive growth and align technical value to business goals.Help shape the future of the Enterprise SE function as a founding member of the team, contributing to playbooks, processes, and cross-functional alignment.Other duties as assigned.
Technical Requirements

· Proficiency in Windows environments (registry, services, performance troubleshooting).

· Familiarity with Linux/macOS systems and basic command-line troubleshooting.

· Strong understanding of networking concepts, including DNS, VPNs, firewalls, and endpoint protections.

· Hands-on experience with ITSM platforms and endpoint lifecycle management.

· Scripting experience in PowerShell, JavaScript, &/or VBScript is strongly preferred.

· Comfortable navigating complex IT ecosystems and integrating with existing infrastructure.

· Experience with Salesforce, Jira, Highspot, or equivalent systems is required.

About You

5+ years in a pre-sales engineering, solutions architecture, or technical consulting role supporting enterprise B2B SaaS customers.Brings deep domain knowledge in enterprise IT operations, RMM, endpoint management, and ITSM-adjacent platforms.Evolved from a technical background (e.g., TAM, support, systems engineer), with practical insight into IT operations at scale.Strong communicator with executive presence—able to tailor messaging for admins, architects, and senior business stakeholders.Understands how IT teams evaluate, implement, and scale solutions—along with insight into the limitations of legacy platforms and the shift toward unified, modern alternatives.Known for high emotional intelligence, technical credibility, and a customer-first mindset.Operates well in ambiguity and brings a builder’s mentality to scaling people, processes, and tools.Bachelor’s degree preferred but not required. Technical certifications (e.g., CISSP, Security+, cloud architecture) are a plus.

About Us

NinjaOne unifies IT to simplify work for nearly 40,000 customers in 140+ countries. ​

The NinjaOne Unified IT Operations Platform delivers endpoint management, autonomous patching, backup, and remote access in a single console to improve efficiency, increase resilience, and reduce spend. By automating IT and managing all endpoints, organizations give employees a great technology experience at work. ​ NinjaOne is obsessed with customer success and has retained a 98% customer satisfaction score for more than 5 years.

What You’ll Love

We are a collaborative, kind, and curious community.

We honor your flexibility needs with full-time work that is hybrid remote.

We have you covered with our comprehensive benefits package, which includes medical, dental, and vision insurance.

We help you prepare for your financial future with our 401(k) plan.

We prioritize your work-life balance with our unlimited PTO.

We reward your work with opportunity for growth and advancement.

Additional Information

This position is NOT eligible for Visa sponsorship.

The benefits available for this position include medical, dental, vision, 401(k) plan, life insurance coverage and PTO. jobs.description:
Performance Drone Works (PDW) is building the next generation of tactical robotic systems used across defense, national security, and public safety missions. We are building a new center of engineering excellence to design our new category of tactical robotic systems and the industrial capacity to deliver them, bringing decisive airpower into the hands of every operator. We are not here to make promises; we are here to deliver real systems with real capabilities for real missions.

You will join a team of operators, engineers, and builders who solve hard problems with humility and focus. We design and produce multi-mission aerial systems that operators trust to perform in real-world conditions, reliably, repeatedly, and at scale. Our approach is grounded in operator-centered design, rapid iteration from field use, and U.S.-based manufacturing. We operate by a clear set of values: Mission First, Aim Farther, Own It, Win Together. This is how we build advantage and how we help protect our service members, our communities, and our country.

Now, we’re entering a new phase of growth and are looking for an Endpoint Management Administrator to join our growing Information Technology team.

What You’ll Do

Configure, image, and prepare laptops, desktops, tablets, and mobile devices for new hires and refresh cycles.Ensure assigned devices receive the correct profiles, configurations, applications, compliance policies, and baseline assignments based on role or department.Administer endpoint management for Windows, macOS, iOS/iPadOS, and Android devices through Microsoft Intune, Jamf, and related tools.Monitor device compliance, patch status, encryption, antivirus, and overall security posture.Apply, validate, and troubleshoot configuration profiles, policies, applications, endpoint agents, remediation scripts, and baseline assignments.Respond to compliance alerts and execute device remediation tasks.Manage mobile application management policies for corporate and BYOD mobile access, including Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace app protection configurations.Maintain documentation for imaging, configuration, troubleshooting, and escalation workflows.Partner with IT Operations, Identity, and Security teams on endpoint standards, device trust, conditional access, and access policy requirements.

Requirements

2–4 years of experience in device management, endpoint administration, MDM/UEM administration, or related IT operations within an enterprise environment.Hands‑on experience provisioning and imaging laptops, desktops, and mobile devices.Proficiency with MDM/UEM platforms such as Intune, Jamf, or similar administration tools. Strong understanding of compliance management, encryption, patch status, and endpoint security posture.Ability to deploy, update, and troubleshoot applications across multiple platforms.Strong troubleshooting skills across device performance, system errors, connectivity, and software issues.Experience collecting logs and performing root cause analysis.Familiarity with security tools, conditional access, antivirus, and compliance workflows.Experience with asset lifecycle management including inventory, refreshes, and disposals. Strong communication skills and experience collaborating with cross functional teams.Ability to create and maintain documentation, SOPs, and knowledge base content.Must have the ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Security Clearance.

Preferred

Experience with advanced Intune administration, remediation scripts, reporting, or automation.Knowledge of macOS administration via Jamf or cross platform UEM solutions.Exposure to scripting (PowerShell, Bash) for endpoint automation or remediation.Background in regulated or fast paced IT environments (manufacturing, defense, engineering, etc.).

Work Environment

This position includes the following:Operates primarily in a professional, climate-controlled office, warehouse, manufacturing and shipping environment. At times, Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) such as safety gloves, goggles, and hearing protection may be required.Employee will also work outdoors to load and receive shipments, where they may be exposed to the elements, including heat, rain, and cold.Standard hours are Monday through Friday 7:00AM to 3:30PM, with occasional overtime as operational needs may require.Fast paced environment with moving, packing, and staging shipments

Benefits

PDW values our team, and we offer a compensation package reflective of your experience and capabilities. Benefits include:

Comprehensive BCBS medical, dental, and vision coverage; 80% sponsored by the company. Safe Harbor 401(K) with company match. Paid Parental Leave. On-site gym at Huntsville, AL & Denver, CO locations. Employer provided life insurance. Robust Employee Assistance Program (EAP). A work environment that encourages teamwork and innovation.
