jobs.description:
1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $400M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

We are seeking a highly motivated Senior IT Engineer to join our IT Engineering — Device Infrastructure Services team. This role goes beyond technical execution, it requires a strong engineer with excellent project management skills, capable of guiding complex device infrastructure initiatives from concept to delivery. They’ll be responsible for driving endpoint management best practices, leading change management processes, and ensuring a seamless, thoughtful end-user experience in a fast-paced SaaS security environment.

The ideal candidate is not only technically skilled in cloud-hosted endpoint management but also a strategic communicator who can collaborate effectively across teams, engage stakeholders at all levels, and advocate for scalable, secure, and efficient enterprise device solutions. They bring a strong user experience focus to everything they ship — from rollout design to end-user communication.

This role reports to the Team Lead, IT Engineering.

How we’re using AI today

Our Engineering, Product, and Design teams are thoughtfully integrating AI across the full software and product development lifecycle to move faster without sacrificing quality or security. In practice, that looks like engineers using AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate reviews and catch bugs earlier, product managers synthesizing user research at scale, and designers rapidly prototyping and iterating with AI-generated mockups. We approach AI the same way we approach security: with clear principles, human accountability at every consequential decision point, and rigorous evaluation before anything ships to customers.

This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US.

What we're looking for:

- 5+ years of technical work experience in an IT role, with 2+ years in an IT engineering or systems administrator role focused on cloud-first endpoint management

- Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles and CI/CD workflows applied to device management In an enterprise fleet at scale (500+ endpoints), meeting security benchmarks such as third-party patch compliance goals.

- Demonstrated senior level experience with Apple MDM platforms e.g Iru

- Hands-on experience designing and shipping automation with agentic or LLM-based components in an IT or device management context — and the judgment to know when existing tooling is the better answer.

- Professional-level scripting abilities in Bash, as well as other shell scripts for endpoint automation and fleet operations

- Hands-on experience implementing device trust principles including phishing-resistant authentication, conditional access, and endpoint compliance policies at scale

Bonus points for:

- Knowledge of IT change management and service management best practices (ITIL, etc.)

- Global-level admin experience with Microsoft Intune

- Ability to script in Powershell

- Admin experience with 1Password Enterprise Password Manager (EPM)

What you can expect:

- Lead the planning and implementation of large-scale device infrastructure projects with broad impact across the organization

- Drive IT Change Management initiatives related to endpoint management, software patching, and fleet operations

- Manage and administer cloud-based Apple MDM platforms (Iru), including custom configuration profiles and advanced policy management

- Apply AI tooling to real infrastructure problems (automated remediation, smarter alerting, reducing the manual toil that slows device ops) and have a hand in deciding where it goes next.

- Own third-party software patching workflows that keep the fleet current with minimal disruption to employees

Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase .

The IT Tooling team sits within IT Support & Services (ITSS) and builds the automations that power ITSS's own operations. Our in-house bot, Ask IT, deflects the majority of company-wide IT requests before they reach a human. Beyond that, we automate ITSS's core day-to-day workflows — ticket triage, access reviews, onboarding and offboarding — which employees experience as self-service. You'll own technical domains within the IT Tooling platform and partner with regional IT teams across APAC, EMEA, and AMER through platforms including n8n, Jira, Okta, Airflow, and Temporal.

What You'll Do

- Own the technical architecture of IT Tooling automations, driving design decisions on system structure, integration patterns, and tooling across n8n, Airflow, Temporal, and Jira

- Establish architecture standards and code review practices that raise the team's overall engineering bar

- Lead as technical DRI on the most complex, highest-impact automation projects, from discovery and design through production delivery

- Partner with Security, Corporate Engineering, and IAM to resolve technical blockers and represent the team in cross-functional architecture discussions

- Build shared frameworks and reusable components that reduce single points of failure across the platform

- Produce architecture documentation and decision records that enable the team to scale with minimal dependency on any single individual

- Manage your own workload with a high degree of independence, translating loosely scoped problems into production-ready technical specifications

Required Skills and Experience

- 5+ years of experience in IT engineering, automation, or systems engineering, with demonstrated ownership of architecture decisions, engineering standards, or platform-level systems that others build on top of

- Deep expertise building and maintaining complex automations using n8n, Airflow, Temporal, Jira Automation, or Workato, paired with strong Git-based development workflows including branching, CI/CD, and code review

- Working knowledge of Okta, Slack API, and Google Workspace administration sufficient to design secure, scalable automation architecture

- Ability to operate in ambiguous environments and translate loosely scoped problems into production-ready technical specifications

- Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

jobs.description:
Truveta provides unprecedented real-world data and real-time intelligence, powered by a dataset built with and owned by US health systems united in a mission of Saving Lives with Data. Together, we power breakthrough medical discoveries, accelerate regulatory-grade evidence, and improve patient care. Today, Truveta enables research on more than 130 million de-identified patients across the US.

Achieving Truveta’s ambitious mission requires an incredible team of talented and inspired people with a special combination of health, software and big data experience who share our company values .

Who We Need

Truveta is rapidly building a talented and diverse team to tackle complex health and technical challenges. We are seeking candidates inspired by the opportunity to securely apply data in the development of real-world health solutions. Beyond core capabilities, we seek problem solvers, passionate and collaborative teammates, and those willing to roll up their sleeves while making a difference. We do things the right way. Our commitment to security and compliance assurance cannot be stressed enough. This position is critical to ensuring we are successful.

If you are interested in the opportunity to pursue purposeful work, join a mission-driven team, and build a rewarding career while having fun, Truveta may be the perfect fit for you.

This Opportunity

The successful candidate will design and support solutions that support the company’s Digital Workplace strategy. They will work on leading edge technologies that help modernize endpoint management by leveraging the cloud to quickly deliver end-user improvements.

Responsibilities:

- Device Management: Define, implement and maintain endpoint hardening baselines for Windows, macOS, and Linux systems with MDM such as Microsoft Intune, and JAMF.

- Policy & Hardening: Develop and enforce security policies, standards, and procedures for all endpoint devices. Implement system hardening configurations based on industry best practices.

- Deploy & Manage Security Tools: Implement, configure, and maintain endpoint security solutions, including Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), Extended Detection and Response (XDR), antivirus/anti-malware software, and host-based firewalls.

- Incident Response: Collaborate with IT and Security team to respond to endpoint-related incidents. Triage, remediate, and contain security incidents and threats on endpoints. Perform forensic analysis when necessary.

- Vulnerability Management: Manage the endpoint vulnerability lifecycle, from discovery and assessment to remediation, using scanning tools and patch management systems.

- Patch Management: Design and oversee the deployment of updates, security patches for operating system and applications.

- Automation & Scripting: Develop scripts and automation (e.g., using Python, PowerShell) to streamline security operations, automate repetitive tasks, and improve response times.

- AI Protection: Secure endpoints used for AI development, including devices accessing model weights, training data, and production inference systems, implementing guardrails on AI tool usage (e.g., prompt injection prevention in local LLM dev tools, restricted plugins/add-ons).

- Data Loss Prevention: Enforce data loss prevention (DLP) and encryption policies on devices used to handle sensitive AI training datasets, including PHI/PII and proprietary corporation data.

- On-call: Ability to participate in On-call rotation.

- On-site: This position requires daily onsite work at Truveta office in Hyderabad.

Qualifications

- Experience: 3-5 years of hands-on experience in an endpoint security, cybersecurity engineering, or similar role.

- Technical Proficiency: Deep understanding of modern operating systems (Windows, macOS) and their architecture, configuration and deployment in a large enterprise environment.

- Cloud Experience : Strong hands-on experience on Azure Cloud PC, VM, Azure Firewall and Azure Networking.

- MDM Expertise: Strong hands-on experience on Microsoft Intune and JAMF administration, such as device enrollment, OS upgrade/patch, configuration, profile.

- Policy Management: Define and assign compliance/security policies to ensure corporation devices meet organizational security standards.

- Application Management: Strong hands-on experience on applications control, deployment, patch and upgrade.

- EPM: Proven experience with industry-leading EPM platforms such as CyberArk and BeyondTrust to control user privileged access and provide advanced threat protection and vulnerability management.

- Networking: Solid understanding of TCP/IP IPv4/v6, experience of office network (Routing / Switching / WAN, Wi-Fi & Security) management and network security concepts.

- Security Principles: Strong knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks (e.g., NIST, MITRE), threat intelligence, and incident response methodologies.

- Compliance: Experiences with SOC 2 Type 2, HITRUST, and ISO compliance frameworks. Interact with the compliance team to ensure the company compliant and remediate gaps during compliance finding and controls.

- Collaboration: Excellent verbal and written communication/presentation, ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

jobs.description:
Overview
As our Endpoint Engineer, you’ll help drive Concora Credit’s Mission to enable customers to Do More with Credit – every single day

The impact you’ll have at Concora Credit:

The Endpoint Engineer will be a key member of our IT team, focusing on designing, implementing, and managing endpoint solutions in alignment with our cloud migration strategy. The ideal candidate should have a strong background in endpoint management, a deep understanding of cloud technologies, and a proven track record of successful migration projects.

We hire people, not positions. That's because, at Concora Credit, we put people first, including our customers, partners, and Team Members. Concora Credit is guided by a single purpose: to help non-prime customers do more with credit. Today, we have helped millions of customers access credit. Our industry leadership, resilience, and willingness to adapt ensure we can help our partners responsibly say yes to millions more. As a company grounded in entrepreneurship, we're looking to expand our team and are looking for people who foster innovation, strive to make an impact, and want to Do More! We’re an established company with over 20 years of experience, but now we’re taking things to the next level. We're seeking someone who wants to impact the business and play a pivotal role in leading the charge for change.

Responsibilities
Primary Responsibilities:

Endpoint Security & Management:

Implement and manage endpoint security measures, ensuring compliance with industry standards and company policies.
Work closely with the cybersecurity team to enhance and maintain robust endpoint security protocols.
Develop, optimize, and troubleshoot Windows Autopilot deployment solutions, including pre-provisioning (White Glove), self-deploying, and user-driven deployment scenarios.
Conduct Windows Readiness and Compatibility Assessment.
Support application packaging, deployments, documentation, and release control (Intune, Adaptive, Patch My PC, etc.).
Work within the change management process to coordinate the release of new software packages.
Participate in multiple Workforce Enablement projects in a fast-paced environment.
Deploy software for service packs or emergency security patches.

Microsoft 365 Administration & Support:

Assist and back up the Microsoft 365 Global Administrator for tenant administration and support
Administer core Microsoft 365 workloads, including Exchange Online & Server SE, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, and Microsoft Teams.
Manage identities, licensing, groups, and role-based access through Entra ID and the Microsoft 365 admin center.
Configure and maintain security and compliance controls, including conditional access, Microsoft Purview, data loss prevention (DLP), and retention policies.
Monitor service health, respond to incidents, and manage service requests and escalations across Microsoft 365 services.
Maintain documentation and runbooks for tenant configuration and administrative procedures to ensure continuity of coverage.

Cloud Migration and Automation:

Integrate and optimize endpoint solutions within our evolving cloud infrastructure, leveraging technologies such as Microsoft Intune, Idira (prev. CyberArk) EPM, Adaptiva, and Patch My PC or equivalent tools.
Identify opportunities to automate endpoint management processes to enhance efficiency and reduce manual intervention.
Implement scripting and automation tools to streamline deployment and maintenance tasks.
Be a key player in continuing the planning and execution of endpoint migration strategies to cloud-based platforms already in motion, ensuring minimal disruption to end-users.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop and implement endpoint solutions compatible with cloud infrastructure.

Additional Responsibilities:

Advancing Workforce AI Strategy & Governance

Develop AI solutions using MS Copilot Studio and Claude to innovate and establish high-value use cases.
Recommend and establish technology positioning (i.e., software development vs. general productivity; buy vs. build: when do we develop skills or agents versus look for AI-enabled commercial products).
Recommend controls and governance to protect endpoint data and systems impacted by AI.
Recommend and establish AI workforce training.
Implement systems for controlled provisioning and permissions.
Implement monitoring, reporting, and dashboards to provide leadership visibility and support decision-making with meaningful data and charts.

Apple Ecosystem:

Proficient in MacOS administration, including system configuration, user account management, and security settings.
Experience in deploying and managing Apple devices, ensuring proper setup, configurations, and centralized management through solutions like Apple Business Manager.
Expertise in implementing and managing security measures specific to macOS, and troubleshooting hardware and software issues efficiently.
Ability to seamlessly integrate Apple devices with other platforms, ensuring smooth collaboration in a heterogeneous corporate environment.
Knowledge of MDM solutions for Apple devices (i.e., MS Intune, Mosyle, etc.), enabling centralized management, configuration, and security policy enforcement.

We know experience comes in many forms and that many skills are transferable. If your experience is close to what we're looking for, consider applying. Diversity has made us the entrepreneurial and innovative company that we are today.

Qualifications
Requirements:

2 - 3 years experience working as an endpoint engineer.
Proficient experience of endpoint management tools like Microsoft Intune, Defender, Endpoint Privilege Management, or similar.
Experience working with formal, enterprise-grade Patch Management and Change Control Systems in a cloud environment.
Strong experience with systems analysis and functional design.
Proficient knowledge of Active Directory and Group Policy.
Familiarity with endpoint encryption solutions.
Proven experience implementing monitoring, reporting, and dashboards.
Proven experience in cloud platforms, such as Microsoft Azure or AWS.
Familiarity with scripting languages (PowerShell, Python, etc.) for automation.
Proven experience developing AI solutions using MS Copilot Studio and Claude to improve process efficiency and innovate
Ability to support iOS mobile devices (iPhone/iPad) in a cloud environment.
Ability to support Virtual Desktop Infrastructure.

Core Competencies Desired

Microsoft Intune
Microsoft Active Directory and Entra ID GPO management
SharePoint Administration
PowerShell scripting
MDM (Mobile Device Manager)
Windows 10 & 11
Endpoint VPN methodologies and best practices
PCI compliance standards & endpoint management best practices
Develop/Maintain comprehensive documentation and architectural design/diagrams.
Provide training and support on new technologies and best practices.
Collaborate & communicate effectively with stakeholders, IT, end-users, peers & 3rd parties.

Certifications (Preferred)

MD-102 Endpoint Administrator Committed to completing in first 6 months in role if not already obtained.
CompTIA SecAI+ (exam CY0-001).
Microsoft Azure Certification(s)
MCSE Certification (Mobility, Productivity Solutions Expert, Cloud Platform and Infrastructure)
Microsoft Certified Professional (MCP)
COMPTIA A+

What’s In It For You:

Medical, Dental and Vision insurance for you and your family
Relax and recharge with Paid Time Off (PTO)
6 company-observed paid holidays, plus 3 paid floating holidays
401k (after 90 days) plus employer match up to 4%
Pet Insurance for your furry family members
Wellness perks including onsite fitness equipment at both locations, EAP, and access to the Headspace App
We invest in your future through Tuition Reimbursement
Save on taxes with Flexible Spending Accounts
Peace of mind with Life and AD&D Insurance
Protect yourself with company paid Long-Term Disability and voluntary Short-Term Disability.

The successful candidate will serve as a key member of the IT team responsible for workstation lifecycle management, onboarding and offboarding activities, endpoint security and compliance, and day-to-day technical support for end users. Deploy, configure, and support Windows, macOS, and Linux endpoints throughout their lifecycle, including provisioning, maintenance, and retirement
Manage employee onboarding and offboarding activities, including hardware deployment, software configuration, account provisioning, and access management
Administer and support Microsoft 365 services, including Active Directory, Entra ID, Intune, Teams, and Microsoft Defender
Provide first- and second-level technical support for endpoint, application, networking, and user-related issues
Maintain endpoint standards, inventory, deployment processes, and device compliance
Support datacenter operations, environmental monitoring and datacenter infrastructure systems
Support office IT infrastructure, including networking, printers, conference room technology, and Teams phone services
Develop and maintain automation solutions and operational tools using PowerShell, Python, Bash, or similar technologies
Create and maintain technical documentation, procedures, and user guides

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)
5+ years of IT systems administration, endpoint management, or IT operations experience
Strong experience deploying, configuring, and troubleshooting Windows desktop and laptop systems
Experience supporting Active Directory, Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, Teams, and Microsoft Defender
Experience supporting and troubleshooting macOS systems
Experience managing endpoint lifecycle processes, including onboarding, deployment, maintenance, and retirement
Experience administering helpdesk or IT service management platform
Strong troubleshooting skills across endpoint, application, and networking technologies
Familiarity with networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, Wi-Fi, and VLAN concepts
Experience with scripting and automation using PowerShell, Python, or similar tools
Excellent customer service, communication, and organizational skills

Preferred Qualifications

Experience administering Linux desktop and server systems
Experience supporting physical security, access-control, or facility management systems

Manual dexterity to operate tools, handle small components, and connect cables.
Visual acuity to read technical manuals, labels, and computer screens.

ABOUT NEC LABORATORIES AMERICA

NEC Laboratories America, Inc. (NEC Labs) is the US-based research center for NEC Corporation’s global network of corporate research laboratories with locations in Princeton, New Jersey, and San Jose, California. NEC Corporation is a leader in integrating IT and network technologies with more than 100 years of expertise in technological innovation to empower people, businesses, and society. We focus on technology research and early market penetration in five primary areas: Data Science & Systems Research, Integrated Systems, Machine Learning, Media Analytics, and Optical Networking & Sensing. jobs.description:
Founded in 1971, Dialysis Clinic, Inc. (DCI) remains the nation’s largest non-profit dialysis provider. With a team of approximately 5,000 talented and caring employees serving across the United States, DCI provides care to nearly 15,000 patients on dialysis and 3,500 patients with chronic kidney disease. We offer a variety of services including in-center hemodialysis, home hemodialysis, and peritoneal dialysis (PD). Each position within DCI, from billers to administrators to nursing staff, contributes toward the goal of providing excellent patient care. Our staff has helped DCI achieve the lowest mortality and hospitalization rates among large dialysis providers for the past 13 years in a row.

The Endpoint Administrator is responsible for managing, securing, and optimizing all User endpoint devices across the organization, including desktops, laptops, mobile devices, and virtual endpoints. This role ensures endpoint compliance with security policies, supports software deployment and patching, and collaborates with IT teams to deliver a seamless user experience on 8,000+ endpoints . Success in this role is measured by endpoint uptime, patch compliance rates, and user satisfaction scores. This position is on-site at our corporate office in Nashville Tennessee.

Schedule: Full-time, Monday through Friday

Compensation: Pay range $60k-$70k, depending on experience

Benefits:

Comprehensive medical, dental and vision benefits
Life and long-term disability insurance provided at no additional expense to employee
Paid time off (PTO) including holidays
Extended Sick Bank (ESB) in addition to PTO – paid time for doctor appointments, sickness or medical leave
Retirement plans with $.50 of each contributed dollar matched for eligible employees, up to 8 percent
Employee assistance program
Wellness program
Among others

Endpoint Management

Administer and maintain endpoint management platforms (e.g., Microsoft Intune, MEM, JAMF).
Deploy and update software packages, patches, and security configurations across all endpoints with a 95%+ patch compliance rate.
Monitor endpoint health and performance using centralized tools, maintaining 99.9% uptime.
Administer and deploy device images for laptops and desktops using MEM or other tools

Security & Compliance

Enforce endpoint security policies including encryption, , and firewall settings.
Respond to endpoint-related security incidents and vulnerabilities.
Ensure compliance with HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC2, and internal security standards.

Support & Troubleshooting

Provide Tier 2/3 support for endpoint-related issues escalated from the help desk
Serve as primary IT support team member for our corporate office, including onsite or remote staff
Troubleshoot hardware and software issues on Windows, macOS, and mobile platforms.
Maintain accurate asset inventory and lifecycle documentation.

Collaboration & Communication

Work closely with infrastructure, cybersecurity, and service desk teams to align endpoint strategies.
Document procedures and contribute to knowledge base articles.
Participate in endpoint-related projects and initiatives.

Security

All employees must ensure that they are aware of and comply with DCI’s information security policies and procedures and are fully committed to implementing them in their daily work routines.
Employees must be responsible for safeguarding DCI’s assets, including information, hardware, software, and intellectual property, from any unauthorized access, disclosure, modification, destruction, or interference.
Employees should report any security events, potential events, or other security risks to the organization in a timely manner to ensure quick mitigation and prevent any further damage.

Education

Preferred: Associate or Bachelor’s degree in a related field.
Experience in lieu of education: 2+ years of relevant endpoint administration experience.

Experience

Required: 2+ years of experience managing enterprise endpoints using tools like Intune, MEM, JAMF, or similar.
Preferred: Experience with scripting (PowerShell, Bash), MDM platforms, and endpoint security tools.

Licenses/Certifications

Preferred: CompTIA A+, Microsoft Certified: Modern Desktop Administrator Associate, or equivalent.
Required: N/A

Skills

Strong knowledge of Windows operating systems.
Familiarity with Active Directory, Group Policy, and endpoint security tools.
Ability to troubleshoot complex endpoint issues.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Strong organizational and documentation skills.

The End User Computing Engineer will support, manage and oversee the day-to-day operations of Goodwill’s end-user computing environment consisting of desktop, mobile devices, printers, POS devices and peripherals across the enterprise.

RESPONSIBILITY LEVEL:

Implements strategies to achieve the goals for the organization and IT infrastructure environment. Implements, revises, and sustains policies, procedures and programs. Typically works on projects and initiatives that span 3 – 12 months.

The End User Computing Engineer will support, manage and oversee the day-to-day operations of Goodwill’s end-user computing environment consisting of desktop, mobile devices, printers, POS devices and peripherals across the enterprise. The desktop engineer also accepts ownership for various projects and implements initiative and assists in the design and planning of POS projects, while providing tier two/three support for other engineers and support team members.

PRINCIPAL DUTIES:

1. Provides strategic, innovative and cost-effective solutions to increase efficiency, reliability, and integration of our EUC services and operations.

2. Develops lifecycle and asset management processes.

3. Develops strategic management processes, including new application and upgrade evaluations.

4. Tests new or enhanced applications including systems enhancements and provides feedback.

5. Deployment of Windows using Microsoft Autopilot.

May serve as a team member or subject matter expert on formal projects or within the department. Effectively engages in change affecting her/him, communicating appropriately with supervisor. Follows through on learning, skill building, and practice necessary to adapt to change.

7. Problem Solving: Light supervision; works independently. Periodic review of work by manager or senior coworker. Solves problems of moderate to advanced complexity; able to identify root cause, interpret data and resolve issues.

8. Technical Skill: Understands and applies professional principles and skills within area of specialization to modify processes to resolve situations.

9. Community Engagement: Champions Goodwill’s community engagement initiatives and serves as an ambassador for Goodwill in the wider community.

10. Complete all other duties/responsibilities as assigned.

1. Associate’s degree or equivalent experience and 3-4 years experience.

2. Excellent customer service skills.

3. Experience with Active Directory

4. Proven ability to provision and troubleshoot O365 accounts.

5. Basic network troubleshooting skills.

6. Experience in Windows Autopilot services setup and deployment.

7. Deep knowledge in Software packaging and distribution using SCCM.

8. Must have reliable transportation, a valid driver’s license and proof of vehicle insurance, as this position may require some travel between locations and the transportation of equipment.

9. Legally authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship.

SKILLS:

1. Ability to work in a semi-autonomous and fast-paced environment.

2. Good Knowledge and experience in Intune configurations, policies and management.

3. Hands on experience in managing Windows Devices with co-management.

CORE CULTURAL COMPETENCIES:

1. Customer Focus: Independently anticipate and meet customer needs, while searching for ways to improve customer service. Internalize customer feedback, and follow up with customer to ensure problems are solved by providing innovative ideas to meet their future needs.

2. Values Differences: Seeks out the diverse perspectives and talents of others, striving to work effectively with others who have different perspectives, backgrounds or styles. Behave with sensitivity towards differences in cultural norms, expectations, and ways of communicating. Challenge stereotyping or offensive comments.

3. Communicates Effectively: Shares information and updates with others, while ensuring a clear, concise and professional communication through reports, documentation, written and other communications. Listens with interest to what others have to say.

4. Situational Adaptability: Demonstrates flexibility of responses to different situations through adapting to the changing needs, conditions, priorities or opportunities. Monitors how well an approach is working to see if a change is needed, recognizing cues that suggest a change in approach or behavior is needed.

5. Drives Results: Demonstrates a strong drive to achieve meaningful results, through driving tasks to successful completion and closure. Sets high standards for own performance, showing determination in the face of obstacles and setbacks.

6. Ensures Accountability: Takes responsibility and ownership for successes and failures in own work. Monitors progress of performance and changes approach accordingly, following through on commitments.

Ability to remain stationary for extended periods. Repetitive use of hands is required in the form of fine manipulations while using a computer keyboard. Must be able to communicate effectively in verbal and written form. Vision is required to transfer written information into electronic databases. Prolonged periods of visual concentration are required. Ability to lift, push and pull a minimum of 50 pounds. Ability to travel between Goodwill locations as needed.

It’s the diversity of our people and their thinking that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do. When we bring everybody in, we can do the best work of our lives. Here, you’ll do more than join something - you’ll add something. As a member of the Retail Device Management team, you will work to handle, secure and support all Apple Retail devices worldwide. You will be responsible for ensuring the quality and reliability of our tools focused on MDM for MacOS and iOS platforms as well as related applications and infrastructure. Your primary focus will be on Mobile Device Management (MDM), front-end, back-end, and accessibility testing.

Description

The Retail Device Management team is looking for a skilled QA tester to help ensure the functionality and quality of the products and services we deliver to retail store end users. This role requires e a strong understanding of testing methodologies which they will apply to MDM protocols, as well as iOS and web applications. You will help to uphold Apple’s quality standards, as well as look for new ways to continue to improve testing methodology and efficacy. We are looking for a candidate who is determined, can constantly research and suggest the latest technologies, independently tackle technical issues, and work with teams of developers, engineering project managers, and end users. As a member of the team, you will lead by example and believe that teams and not individuals accomplish extraordinary things! RESPONSIBILITIES: - MDM Testing: Execute comprehensive MDM tests on various mobile platforms, including iOS and macOS, using industry-leading MDM solutions. Apply MDM capabilities to manage device enrollment, configuration, and app distribution. - Front-End Testing: Design, develop, and implement automated and manual front-end tests on web and mobile applications. Ensure a flawless user experience, phonetically and functionally, across different browsers and devices. Implement usability and user acceptance testing (UAT) methodologies. - Back-End Testing: Collaborate closely with developers to test the back-end systems. Perform API testing, database queries, stress testing, and scalability testing to identify and resolve performance issues. - Accessibility Testing: Conduct detailed accessibility audits of our applications to ensure compliance with web accessibility guidelines. Implement remediation strategies to improve accessibility for users. - Reporting and Communication: Document testing results, defects, and issues in a clear and concise manner. Apply Jira or similar project management tool to track testing progress and collaborate with multi-functional teams. Effective written and verbal communication skills are crucial for conveying technical information to stakeholders. - Stay Up-to-Date: Keep up with the latest trends and technologies in mobile applications, MDM, front-end, back-end, and accessibility testing. Participate in training and workshops to improve skills and stay informed about industry standard processes. Internship as a QA Tester with a focus on MDM, front-end, back-end, or accessibility testing Knowledge of front-end technologies, including HTML, CSS, or JavaScript Knowledge of back-end technologies, such as server-side programming, databases, and APIs

Preferred Qualifications

Strong understanding of Mobile Device Management (MDM) concepts and solutions. Experience with manual testing methodologies and toolkits. Proficiency in programming languages like Python or Java for automated testing. Familiarity with accessibility testing tools and guidelines. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Attention to detail and ability to identify and reproduce bugs. Excellent interpersonal skills. Apple Retail experience.

Pay & Benefits

At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $117,800 and $177,900, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.

Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple’s discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple’s Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You’ll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses - including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. Learn more about Apple Benefits.

Note: Apple benefit, compensation and employee stock programs are subject to eligibility requirements and other terms of the applicable plan or program.

jobs.description:
Endpoint Platform Staff Engineer

THE POSITION Our roster has an opening with your name on it

As a Staff Endpoint Platform Engineer, you are the technical anchor of our endpoint fleet strategy - responsible for setting the course for how FanDuel manages, automates, and secures its device fleet at scale. You own the architecture. You drive the roadmap. You define what "secure and well-managed" means across macOS, iOS, Android, and Windows - and you build the systems, patterns, and standards that make it durable long after you've moved on to the next problem.

This isn't an execution-only role. You'll partner across Security, Enterprise Technology, and more to translate complex, ambiguous operational challenges into coherent platform solutions - and you'll mentor the engineers around you to do the same. You bring deep craft, organizational influence, and a bias toward solving problems permanently rather than repeatedly.

You will report to the Sr. Manager of Cyber Defense Engineering.

In addition to the specific responsibilities outlined above, employees may be required to perform other such duties as assigned by the Company. This ensures operational flexibility and allows the Company to meet evolving business needs.

THE GAME PLAN

Everyone on our team has a part to play

• Define and own the multi-year technical strategy for FanDuel's global endpoint fleet - establishing engineering principles and reusable configuration patterns that set the standard for how our team builds and operates.

• Architect and drive delivery of scalable, secure-by-default device baselines across macOS, iOS, Android, and Windows - ensuring every device in the fleet is compliant, performant, and trusted from zero-touch provisioning through offboarding.

• Lead the design and implementation of GitOps-driven endpoint configuration management and CI/CD validation pipelines - ensuring platform changes are peer-reviewed, auditable, and resistant to configuration drift.

• Define the KPIs that matter - provisioning speed, compliance drift, patch latency, device trust posture - and build the telemetry and automation to track, report on, and continuously improve them.

• Mentor and develop engineers on the team by modeling technical excellence, providing thoughtful feedback, and investing in their craft.

• Proactively identify platform risks, technical debt, and emerging opportunities - and intervene when work is off-course to change direction before it becomes a bigger problem.

• Use AI as a force multiplier - for automation, operational efficiency, and engineering quality - across everything you do.

• Support the security organization as necessary. Anything is possible when we operate as one team.

THE STATS

What we're looking for in our next teammate

• Extensive hands-on experience architecting, designing, and managing large-scale Unified Endpoint Management (UEM) and enterprise MDM platforms at scale - think Jamf Pro, Microsoft Intune, FleetDM, or equivalent - across multi-OS enterprise environments.

• Proven track record owning a platform strategy end-to-end - defining the roadmap, building alignment, navigating tradeoffs, and delivering durable outcomes across organizational boundaries.

• Strong automation and platform engineering depth - proficiency in Bash, PowerShell, and/or Python

• Hands-on experience deploying Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, Ansible, or equivalent) and GitOps workflows in production.

• Deep understanding of endpoint and mobile security ecosystems across iOS, Android, macOS, and Windows -Microsoft MAM, Secure Remote Access/Conditional Access approaches, and endpoint protection are a few you can expect to have impact in.

• Track record of mentoring and developing engineers - sharing knowledge broadly through documentation, design reviews, and direct coaching; actively participating in hiring and calibration for senior roles.

• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills - you can diagnose a complex fleet issue, translate the fix to non-technical stakeholders, and write the architecture doc that prevents the next one.

• Comfortable operating in fast-paced, ambiguous environments - able to set direction with incomplete information, raise blockers early, and drive to decisions even when consensus is hard.

ABOUT FANDUEL

FanDuel Group is the premier mobile gaming company in the United States and Canada. FanDuel Group consists of a portfolio of leading brands across mobile wagering including: America's #1 Sportsbook, FanDuel Sportsbook; its leading iGaming platform, FanDuel Casino; the industry's unquestioned leader in horse racing and advance-deposit wagering, FanDuel Racing; and its daily fantasy sports product.

In addition, FanDuel Group operates FanDuel TV, its broadly distributed linear cable television network and FanDuel TV+, its leading direct-to-consumer OTT platform. FanDuel Group has a presence across all 50 states, Canada, and Puerto Rico.

The company is based in New York with US offices in Los Angeles, Atlanta, and Jersey City, as well as global offices in Canada and Scotland. The company's affiliates have offices worldwide, including in Ireland, Portugal, Romania, and Australia.

FanDuel Group is a subsidiary of Flutter Entertainment, the world's largest sports betting and gaming operator with a portfolio of globally recognized brands and traded on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: FLUT).

PLAYER BENEFITS

We treat our team right

We offer amazing benefits above and beyond the basics. We have an array of health plans to choose from (some as low as $0 per paycheck) that include programs for fertility and family planning, mental health support, and fitness benefits. We offer generous paid time off (PTO & sick leave), annual bonus and long-term incentive opportunities (based on performance), 401k with up to a 5% match, commuter benefits , pet insurance, and more - check out all our benefits here:
FanDuel Total Rewards . *Benefits differ across location, role, and level.

FanDuel is an equal opportunities employer and we believe, as one of our principles states, "We are One Team!". As such, we are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by state, local or federal law. We believe FanDuel is strongest and best able to compete if all employees feel valued, respected, and included.

The applicable salary range for this position is $146,000-$182,000 USD, which is dependent on a variety of factors including relevant experience, location, business needs and market demand. This role may offer the following benefits: medical, vision, and dental insurance; life insurance; disability insurance; a 401(k) matching program; among other employee benefits. This role may also be eligible for short-term or long-term incentive compensation, including, but not limited to, cash bonuses and stock program participation. This role includes paid personal time off and 14 paid company holidays. FanDuel offers paid sick time in accordance with all applicable state and federal laws.

FanDuel is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please email Benefits@fanduel.com.

jobs.description:
Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We're looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As a Windows Low Level Engineer - Endpoint security, you will design and develop advanced security features for SentinelOne's Windows endpoint protection platform, operating across both user-mode and kernel-mode environments. You will build and optimize mission-critical components including anti-tampering protections, network sensors, and agent infrastructure while solving complex performance and stability challenges at massive scale. By researching Windows internals and debugging deep system issues, you will collaborate with distributed engineering teams to deliver high-impact security capabilities protecting millions of devices worldwide.

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Software Engineer with a strong background in low-level C++ programming and a deep understanding of Windows OS, to help us in developing our Endpoint Protection product, the core part of our business, and to join one of our Platform group teams. (We're currently growing multiple teams and are open to new colleagues with a wide variety of backgrounds within Windows development!).

The Platform group teams are in charge of some of our most complex low-level areas, such as:

Windows agent's Anti-Tampering (self-protection from malware attempting to harm the agent), network sensors, device control, and other kernel-side features involving both research and development,usermode security & agent infrastructures - e.g. installers, logging, services such as communication layer & interfaces for our Windows agent, for improving the quality, performance & stability of the agent and making the user experience smoother.By joining our group, you will collaborate with talented engineers who are leading a feature through the whole development lifecycle. Your work will have an impact on millions of endpoints in one of the mainstream areas of the EPP/EDR agent of SentinelOne - a product recognized 5x-in-a-row as Gartner MQ Leader, scoring highly in many MITRE Att&ck assessments, valued by users in Gartner Peer Insights and more.

What will you do?

As a new member of one of our distributed development teams, you will work in both user-mode & kernel-mode, and deal with a large variety of fields.You will have the chance to design, develop primarily in modern C++ (23), test and debug the most complicated real-world problems (often unseen before). In order to successfully deal with this challenge, you will continuously enrich your knowledge and experience with Windows OS internals & Kernel, Endpoint Protection, and Endpoint Detection & Response eco-system.Our teams design and execute significant new features, as well as rewrite and reimplement the existing ones from scratch. You will also deal with extraordinary performance & optimization challenges, given the scale of our cybersecurity SW (handling hundreds of billions of events every day).Your work will influence the security of tens of millions of Windows devices, that we protect at enterprise & government customers across the globe (incl. 4 of Fortune 10 and hundreds of Global 2000).You'll also be encouraged to share knowledge within both Platform teams and the broader Windows group.Working setup: Flexible working hours, this is a 100% remote role on full-time permanent employment (UoP) based within Poland. We provide optional membership in major coworking chains. Currently for this role in Poland we are able to consider only candidates that are already eligible to work in the EU at the time of applying. Optionally for those willing to relocate to the Czech Republic relocation assistance is available for any candidates that are already eligible to work in the EU at the time of applying.What skills & knowledge should you bring?

Multiple years of experience as a software engineer in the area of lowlevel programming using modern C++ (or using C and a willingness to learn modern C++)Hands-on experience and in-depth understanding of Windows OS design & internals, Windows low-level development, with debugging of Windows applications and familiarity with related standard debugging and profiling toolsPrevious experience working on a production-grade product with a wide-scale deploymentGreat communication skills and the ability to work both independently and with peers from different time zones, problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinkingAttention to detail and high coding standardsAn advantage: experience with Windows Kernel and Windows Drivers development, experience in security-oriented development, with reversing or malware analysisWhy SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family:

Equity & Rewards

Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)Time Off & Wellbeing

Competitive leave benefitsGender-neutral parental leaveInsurance & Financial Security

Medical and insurance benefitsPension schemeEmployee Assistance Program (EAP)Work Perks & Flexibility

Wellness benefitSentinelOne is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. Job Summary

Your Career

As the Principal for Competitive Intelligence within the Cortex Product Management organization, you are the strategic link between the competitive landscape and our product roadmap. You don't just report on the market—you influence what we build. By applying Structured Analytic Techniques (SATs) to technical competitive data, you will provide the "Inconvenient Truths" that challenge our product assumptions and ensure that Cortex maintains a structural architectural advantage validated by evidence and field reality.

Qualifications

Your Impact

Own the Agentic Endpoint Security Competitive Picture. AES is a fast-moving market where today's architecture decisions define tomorrow's winners. You will maintain a continuously updated, evidence-based view of how the competitive landscape is evolving and translate it into product decisions that keep Cortex ahead.

Separate Architecture from Marketing. The AES market conflates detection with enforcement, posture with runtime, and rule-based blocking with behavioral detection. You will produce rigorous technical teardowns that distinguish what competitors actually do from what they claim — and make sure our teams know the difference.

Define the Counter-Narrative. Partner with the Enablement Lead to build technical "Kill" campaigns that dismantle competitor claims at the moments that matter — at launch, at renewal, and inside active deals.

Defend and Expand the Technical Moat. Track where Cortex holds genuine structural advantages and where the market is closing those gaps. Identify the product decisions required to sustain or extend those advantages.

Own the Endpoint Security and AES Intersection. The convergence of EPP/EDR and Agentic Endpoint Security is where the most significant competitive pressure is emerging. You will identify patterns across wins and losses in this space and deliver the objective analysis Product and Engineering need to respond.

Track the Analyst Narrative. Category definitions in AES are still being written. You will monitor how analysts are framing the space and ensure our product and messaging strategy stays ahead of placements that shape enterprise procurement decisions.

Qualifications

Your Experience

8+ years in Competitive Intelligence, Product Management, or Sales Engineering within cybersecurity, with deep expertise in EPP/EDR, XDR, and AI-driven security.

Mastery of Structured Analytic Techniques: You produce high-nuance, threat-focused analysis that goes well beyond feature matrices — work that withstands scrutiny from senior Product and Engineering executives.

Technical depth in endpoint security: You understand the architectural distinctions that matter in this space — between rule-based enforcement and behavioral detection, between posture-based discovery and runtime visibility, between proxy-layer and host-native approaches — and can assess where a competitor's architecture hits structural ceilings.

Familiarity with the agentic AI threat landscape: You understand how AI agents interact with enterprise systems and what that means for detection and enforcement architectures.

Radical Candor: You are entirely comfortable delivering Inconvenient Truths to product leadership about where our strategy is falling short, backed by irreproachable evidence.

Executive Communication and BLUF Mastery: You can distill dense technical and market analysis into concise, high-impact briefings that directly steer executive decision-making.

Red Team Product Facilitation. Experience running adversarial workshops for product launches — simulating how competitors will attempt to undercut new capabilities in the field.

Preferred Qualifications

Prior experience as an Endpoint PM, Detection Engineer, or TME — you should be able to have a peer-level conversation about telemetry coverage, detection content, and enforcement trade-offs.

Hands-on understanding of how AI-driven security products behave in production SOC environments, including where autonomous response capabilities break down at scale.

Familiarity with how AI agents are being deployed in the enterprise — the deployment models, the integration points, and the threat surfaces they create.

Advanced use of ACH or similar formal intelligence frameworks to objectively evaluate competitor claims.

CI certification (CIP or equivalent) or formal intelligence training is a plus.

Please submit your resume to the opportunities below to become a part of the Ventura Tech team. If no positions are listed, please check back frequently for openings.

Please be aware that the job opportunities listed here are the only ones available. We exclusively share job postings from our certified Ventura Tech website.

IT Systems Engineer (Client-Facing | MSP)

Ventura Tech is a Bay Area–based Managed Services Provider focused on delivering Worry-Free IT through proactive support, modern cloud services, robust endpoint security, and reliable client experiences. We support organizations that depend on secure, well-managed technology to run their businesses. Our culture is built on technical excellence, accountability, teamwork, and trust. We’re practical, professional, and focused on doing the work right with a white glove touch.

As an IT Systems Engineer (Client-Facing | MSP), you will be a senior technical contributor responsible for resolving complex issues, executing projects, and supporting secure, reliable client environments. This is a hands-on engineering role focused on delivery and execution. And to be clear: we’re not looking for any geek off the street. We’re looking for engineers who show up prepared, communicate clearly, take ownership, and can be trusted in high-visibility client environments.

Why Join Ventura Tech?

With over 20 years of excellence, Ventura Tech is guided by our core values.

People First: We value every individual—both our team and our clients.

Accountability: We take pride in owning our work and delivering results.

Teamwork: A good day for one is a good day for all.

Humor: We enjoy what we do and share a laugh along the way.

Growth: Continuous improvement keeps us ahead of the game.

Whether you aim to deepen your technical expertise or pursue a senior role, Ventura Tech is here to support your career journey.

Core Traits:

Reliability: Show up prepared, follow through on commitments, and be someone clients and teammates can consistently depend on.

Integrity: Be a good person, have core values, a sense of humor, and a strong ability to communicate outstandingly with clients and co-workers.

Mentorship: Teach clients and team members alike with patience and clarity.

Ownership: Take charge of projects from start to finish.

Curiosity: Be a tech enthusiast who loves learning, tinkering, and mastering new skills.

Collaboration: Know when to ask for help and work effectively with the team.

Responsibilities

Provide advanced technical support onsite and remotely and serve as an escalation point across client environments throughout the Bay Area as needed.

Support cloud productivity and identity platforms (Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Azure AD / Entra ID).

Manage and secure endpoints across Windows, macOS, and mobile devices using modern management and EDR tools.

Set up and onboard new systems and users, ensuring devices, access, security, and core services are configured correctly from day one.

Troubleshoot networking technologies including firewalls, VLANs, DNS, DHCP, and wireless systems.

Support conferencing and collaboration platforms such as Zoom, Microsoft Teams, and Google Meet, including conference room hardware for high-profile client meetings.

Document systems, changes, and resolutions clearly and thoroughly.

Keep detailed track of all issues, resolution steps and time in Ventura Tech ticketing system.

Always exercise good judgment, discretion, and professionalism when communicating with clients and vendors.

Qualifications

5+ years of hands-on IT systems or MSP experience.

Strong networking fundamentals (DNS, DHCP, VLANs, VPN’s, routing, firewalls, wireless).

Experience with cloud-first and hybrid environments using Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, and Azure AD / Entra ID, AWS.

Experience supporting modern email platforms (Microsoft 365 Exchange Online, Google Workspace) and client applications (Outlook, macOS Mail).

Strong experience supporting Windows and macOS devices in managed, security-focused environments.

Thorough experience with endpoint security, patching, and device management.

Familiarity with backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity solutions.

Experience supporting conferencing and collaboration platforms (Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Google Meet), including room systems.

Excellent troubleshooting, time management, and communication skills with meticulous attention to detail and white glove customer service.

Must have a valid driver’s license and a vehicle for client on-site work.

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Electronics or Computer Science.

Relevant MSP certifications: Microsoft servers, Azure/M365, CompTIA Network+, Security+ (Cisco is a plus).

Familiarity with ConnectWise Business Management software.

Familiarity with N-Able or other RMM software.

Experience with design applications such as Adobe Suite and CAD apps.

Perks and Benefits

Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance.

401(k) retirement plan.

The Senior Engineer is a hands-on modern workplace engineer responsible for building, configuring, and supporting Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Intune solutions with a strong emphasis on endpoint management, identity integration, and Zero Trust-aligned controls. This role executes scoped engineering work, troubleshoots complex issues and escalations, and contributes to operational readiness through documentation and runbooks. The position works under the direction of technical leads/architects (no direct technical leadership responsibilities)

Key Responsibilities:

Engineering & Escalation Support: Own advanced troubleshooting for Microsoft 365 and Intune issues (enrollment, compliance, app deployment, Conditional Access impact, endpoint security policy conflicts). Perform root cause analysis, document findings, and implement corrective actions under change control.
Collaboration & Handoffs: Work closely with onshore leads/architects, security, identity, messaging/collaboration, and networking teams to execute assigned work packages. Provide clear status updates, validate dependencies, and ensure smooth handoffs to operations and support teams.
Project Delivery (Execution Focus): Deliver scoped engineering tasks aligned to project plans (policy implementation, testing, pilot support, remediation, and deployment activities). Track work items, raise risks early, and support cutovers and post-deployment stabilization to meet SLAs and project milestones.
Microsoft 365 / Intune Configuration: Configure and support Microsoft Intune and core M365 services based on defined standards, including Entra ID integration, Conditional Access configurations, device enrollment (Windows Autopilot, ADE/DEP, Android Enterprise), compliance policies, configuration profiles, app deployment (Win32/LOB/store), Windows Update for Business, and lifecycle operations. Endpoint Security Controls: Implement and maintain endpoint security configurations including Intune security baselines, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint onboarding/configuration support, ASR rules, BitLocker/FileVault policies, local admin controls, and remediation of security findings. Assist with evidence gathering for audits and support incident response activities as needed.
Documentation & Continuous Improvement: Create and maintain runbooks, SOPs, troubleshooting guides, and knowledge articles. Identify recurring issues and propose automation/standardization opportunities (PowerShell, Microsoft Graph) to improve reliability and reduce manual effort.

Required Qualifications:

Experience: 6+ years in IT, with 3+ years focused on Microsoft 365 and/or endpoint management. Demonstrated experience supporting production environments, handling escalations, and executing project work with minimal supervision.
Microsoft 365 / Endpoint Expertise: Strong hands-on administration experience with Microsoft 365 and Intune, including Entra ID, Conditional Access fundamentals, Intune device/app management, and M365 service operations (service health, incident management, and change control). Working knowledge of Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint/OneDrive administration and common end-user issues.
Modern Endpoint Management: Experience managing Windows (primary), and familiarity with macOS, iOS/iPadOS, and Android at scale. Hands-on work with Autopilot, configuration profiles, compliance policies, app packaging/deployment (Win32, LOB, store apps), and patch/update strategies (Windows Update for Business). Experience with troubleshooting enrollment and policy/app conflicts.
Security & Compliance Knowledge: Practical experience implementing or supporting endpoint security controls (Defender for Endpoint, Intune endpoint security, BitLocker, ASR) and understanding of Zero Trust concepts (identity/device conditional access, least privilege). Ability to support audit requests and remediation activities in regulated environments.
Automation & Scripting: Working PowerShell skills and familiarity with Microsoft Graph for reporting, bulk changes, and operational automation. Ability to read/modify scripts, troubleshoot failures, and follow secure coding practices.
Soft Skills: Strong troubleshooting mindset, attention to detail, and clear written/verbal communication. Ability to document work thoroughly, collaborate across time zones, and manage multiple tickets/tasks while meeting SLAs.

Overview

About Susquehanna

Susquehanna is a global quantitative trading firm founded by a group of friends who share a passion for game theory and probabilistic thinking. We have incorporated this approach into our culture, where you will find relentless problem solvers within each of our core disciplines: Trading, Technology, and Quantitative Research. From offices around the world, our employees collaborate to make optimal decisions and are driven by the desire to achieve winning results together.

What we do

We are experts in trading essentially all listed financial products and asset classes, with a focus on derivatives trading. Through market making and market taking, we handle millions of trading transactions around the world every day, providing liquidity and ensuring competitive prices for buyers and sellers. While our presence in the market is broad, our trading desks are highly specialized, allowing for a deep understanding of unique drivers of each asset class.

Team Overview:

Our Platform Services team is an integral part of the Compute and Storage Platforms (CASP) team at Susquehanna and shares responsibility for building and managing all 15,000+ servers and 250+ PB of storage that composes our critical trade focused infrastructure. Joining Platform Services is the first step in building an engineering career with Susquehanna and provides you with opportunities to:

Rotate across technology spaces

As part of the team, you will be able to rotate with senior engineers specializing in Windows, Linux, Virtualization, Storage, and open source technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, Ansible, and Grafana. During these rotations you will partner with engineers to learn the fundamentals of their spaces and help them solve complex problems from building out new environments, evaluating and creating new applications, performance tuning, automation, and configuration management.

Work with mentors

In each rotation you will be paired with one or more mentors that will guide you through your technical growth and Susquehanna's environment. In addition to dealing with day-to-day project work, together you will pinpoint your areas of interest and avenues for growth. You will also work closely with the rest of our teams through design/white board sessions, problem solving discussions, and ongoing project and team updates.

Address and solve challenging technical problems

At Susquehanna we want your help to solve challenging problems! Partner with technologists across Susquehanna's environment to troubleshoot application, network, hardware, and other issues while learning and debating the best solution to fit the scenario. You will have the freedom to test and implement your solutions at scale in our onsite labs consisting of over 600 physical and virtual servers.

Engage with bleeding edge technology

Susquehanna is always looking at the latest technology to see where we can increase speed and performance for competitive advantage while managing risk and enhancing stability. You may have the opportunity to help test out new hardware that isn’t generally available (server hardware, network cards, flash storage), work on emerging platforms geared toward container orchestration (Kubernetes, Service Fabric), or work on high performance clustered environments responsible for driving our quantitative trading.

The shift for this role rotates daily between three shifts: 7:00am-4:00pm(Production Lead), 9:00am-6:00pm and 11:00am-8:00pm(Late Support). There is one Production Lead and Late Support per day and the rest of the team works 9:00am-6:00pm. Applicants must be willing to work these shifts

jobs.description:
Windows Systems Engineer
About Trellis
Trellis builds and deploys computer-use AI agents that get patients access to life-saving medicine. Our agents process billions of dollars worth of therapies a year, automating document intake, prior authorizations, and appeals at scale — classifying medical referrals, understanding chart notes, and automating contract and reimbursement search to give patients accurate coverage determinations and cost responsibility. The result is streamlined operations and faster care for patients in all fifty states.

We're a spinout from the Stanford AI Lab, backed by leading investors including Y Combinator, General Catalyst, and Telesoft Partners, alongside executives at Google and Salesforce.

The Role
We're hiring a Windows Systems Engineer to own the Windows Server and Remote Desktop Services (RDS) infrastructure that powers our fleet of computer-use agents. This is a deeply hands-on systems engineering role: you'll keep the session hosts, service accounts, scheduled tasks, and underlying Windows environments stable, performant, and recoverable — at a scale where downtime has real consequences.

The Scale
The infrastructure you'll own operates at serious scale and directly supports patient care:

Thousands of computer-use agents running concurrently, 24/7

20M+ prescriptions processed every year
400 clinics live across all 50 states

$15B+ in medications dispensed flowing through the systems you keep running

When a session host hangs or an agent stalls, it isn't an abstract SLA breach — it's a clinic waiting on a prescription. Reliability here is the job.

Key Responsibilities
Windows Server Operations

Administer and maintain a fleet of Windows Server hosts: patching, reboots, and upgrades with minimal disruption
Diagnose and remediate runaway processes, memory leaks, high CPU, and zombie sessions on live hosts
Manage scheduled tasks for agent startup, watchdogs, and automated recovery
Configure networking, service wrappers, and per-agent tunneling
Own the identity and access plumbing — service accounts, permissions, and Group Policy / Active Directory where it touches the fleet

RDS & Session Management

Administer RDS Session Hosts: session limits, autologon, persistence, and recovery of dropped or frozen sessions
Manage RDS licensing (CALs, grace periods) and troubleshoot licensing-related failures
Handle loopback/local RDP architectures and use session shadowing to debug live agents

Fleet Provisioning, Scaling & Lifecycle

Provision and decommission agents on demand, including service accounts, sessions, and per-agent environments
Manage capacity, rebalance load across hosts, and scale session-host capacity up or down to match demand
Roll out upgrades safely with staged/canary rollouts and clear rollback plans
Maintain golden images so hosts and agents come up consistently and predictably

jobs.description:
We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Windows and Mac OS Endpoint Engineer II to join our dynamic IT team. This role is central to building a modern desktop platform for our end users, managing and maintaining endpoint devices to ensure optimal performance, security, and compliance with organizational standards. We need someone with a deep understanding of both Windows and Mac OS environments and management tools, who can troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues.

## Education and Experience

### Required:

An undergraduate degree in engineering or computer science is required, or 5+ years of work experience in an IT endpoint engineering role in lieu of a degree. You must have experience designing and developing Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (MECM), Intune, and Jamf Pro solutions for application distribution, configuration management, asset management, and other endpoint lifecycle capabilities, following the least privilege security model. Scripting experience is needed, focused on automating management of Windows endpoints and user data migration to new computers. You should have experience designing, testing, and implementing configuration, compliance, and conditional access policies within Azure, along with Active Directory or Azure group policies. Virtual Desktop solution experience is also necessary. Familiarity with endpoint security best practices—including antivirus, encryption, and patch management—is essential. Strong attention to detail and the ability to operate across multiple priorities are required. You must have excellent verbal and written communication skills for a wide range of audiences, including executives, business stakeholders, and IT teams. A high degree of adaptability to keep pace with rapid changes in IT technology is key.

### Preferred:

Demonstrated experience bringing state-of-the-art endpoint management capabilities into a large, geographically distributed environment is highly valued. We prefer candidates with experience architecting and engineering deployment workflows using JAMF and Microsoft Autopilot. Proficiency in scripting languages such as PowerShell, Bash, or Python for automation tasks is a plus. Relevant certifications like Microsoft Certified: Modern Desktop Administrator Associate, Jamf Certified Tech, or similar are also preferred.

## Core Work Activities

In this role, you will provide support, oversight, governance, and tactical direction for delivering end user IT services. You'll contribute significantly to the overall end user infrastructure architecture and operational governance model. This involves researching, designing, and implementing standards-based, high-performing, highly available, and secure components that deliver required business functionality. You will provide operational guidance to the enterprise on endpoint management platforms. Regular assessments of the current environment to detect critical deficiencies and recommend improvements are part of the role. You'll use capability modeling to align systems strategy with business goals and consult with project teams to modify services as needed. Implementing and promoting standard configuration and change management processes and practices is expected. You will develop test plans, implementation plans, and project timelines, as well as provide work assignments and mentorship to a team of user infrastructure engineers using industry best practices. Routine status reporting on compliance and health of end user endpoints is required.

### Delivering Technology:

You will perform quantitative and qualitative analyses for service delivery processes and projects, supporting existing systems and projects in at least one environment. This includes reviewing completeness of requirements before solutioning, planning and coordinating implementations, and reviewing quality control of systems functional design, usability, and functionality. Coordination with IT and vendor relations teams is needed, along with ensuring early warning to leadership about degraded or missed service levels.

### IT Governance:

A key part of this role is implementing and using automation to discover, manage, and remediate endpoints—including BIOS settings, BIOS and driver upgrades, software patches, and other configurable items—to effectively manage and ensure compliance. You will develop dashboard constructs to provide insights into compliance, status, and a real-time overview of end-user device key performance indicators (KPIs) or data points. Developing and maintaining detailed process and control documentation is also expected.
